-- Native implementation of output/imagegen/while-you-were-away-clean-v1.png.
-- One full P&L amount comes from the server's return snapshot. Trades are always shown.
local TextService=game:GetService("TextService")
local View={}
local FONT=Enum.Font.FredokaOne
local LEFT,CENTER,RIGHT=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
local function netPnl(summary)return (summary.Realized or 0)+(summary.Unrealized or 0)end
function View.ShouldShow(summary)
 return summary~=nil and (#(summary.Rows or {})>0 or netPnl(summary)~=0)
end
function View.Draw(ctx,w,h,summary,dismiss)
 local C=ctx.C
 local scale=math.min((w-24)/360,1.28)
 local compact=h-24<474*scale
 if compact then scale=math.min(scale,1)end
 local function px(n)return math.round(n*scale)end
 local pw=px(360)
 local baseHeight=math.min(h-24,px(compact and 356 or 474))
 local pad=px(22);local iw=pw-2*pad

 panel:SetAttribute("StaticButtons",true)
 ctx.round(panel,px(20));ctx.stroke(panel,C.Cyan).Thickness=2

  return t
 end
 local function color(n)return n<0 and C.Red or n>0 and C.Green or C.Muted end
 local secs=math.max(0,math.floor(summary.Seconds or 0))
 local elapsed=secs>=86400 and string.format("%dd %dh",secs//86400,secs%86400//3600)
  or secs>=3600 and string.format("%dh %dm",secs//3600,secs%3600//60)
  or secs>=60 and string.format("%dm %ds",secs//60,secs%60)or string.format("%ds",secs)

  ctx.round(f,px(3));f.Rotation=ray[5]
 end
 local titleX=px(compact and 82 or 128)

 for i,row in ipairs(rows)do

  copy("Trade"..i,row.Contract.." · "..(row.Direction>0 and "Long "or "Short ")..row.Quantity,17)

 local buttonY=ph-bottomPad-buttonH;local viewportH=buttonY-px(14)-bodyTop

 local continue=ctx.button(panel,"Continue","Continue",pad-px(4),buttonY,iw+px(8),buttonH,dismiss,C.Raised,C.Text,px(compact and 23 or 27),45)
 ctx.gloss(continue,"Purple");continue.Corners.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,px(14));continue.Border.Thickness=px(3)
 panel:SetAttribute("SummaryId",summary.Id);panel:SetAttribute("Total",total);panel:SetAttribute("TradeCount",#rows)

end

 end

 make("TextLabel","Privacy",panel,{Position=UDim2.new(0,160,1,-48),Size=UDim2.new(1,-178,0,32),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="Only visible to you",TextSize=12,Font=Enum.Font.Gotham,TextWrapped=true,TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(165,187,219),TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right})

ChartPaintPool.luau:
-- Retained chart primitives: unchanged properties never invalidate Roblox's GUI layout.
-- Only candle geometry animates; execution prices and candle data remain authoritative.
local Pool={} Pool.__index=Pool
function Pool.new(root)
 return setmetatable({Root=root,Parents={},Objects={},Entries={},Moving={},Epoch=0,CanAnimate=false,Duration=0.08},Pool)
end
function Pool:Begin(animate)
 self.Epoch+=1 self.CanAnimate=animate==true
 if not self.CanAnimate then self:Snap() end
 for _,bucket in pairs(self.Parents)do table.clear(bucket.Counts)end
end
-- Without an identity, objects are reused by draw order. With one (a candle's time), the same
-- candle always owns the same objects, so panning can never hand a candle another candle's paint.
function Pool:Get(class,name,parent,identity)
 local bucket=self.Parents[parent]
 if not bucket then bucket={Counts={},Lists={},Keyed={}} self.Parents[parent]=bucket end
 local key=class..":"..name local entry
 if identity~=nil then
  local keyed=bucket.Keyed[key] if not keyed then keyed={} bucket.Keyed[key]=keyed end
  entry=keyed[identity]
  if not entry then
   local object=Instance.new(class) object.Name=name object.Parent=parent
   entry={Object=object,Values={},Gui=object:IsA("GuiObject"),Stroke=class=="UIStroke",Motion={},Keyed=keyed,Identity=identity,Key=identity}
   keyed[identity]=entry self.Entries[object]=entry table.insert(self.Objects,entry)
  end
 else
 local index=(bucket.Counts[key]or 0)+1 bucket.Counts[key]=index
 local list=bucket.Lists[key] if not list then list={} bucket.Lists[key]=list end
 entry=list[index]
 if not entry then
  local object=Instance.new(class) object.Name=name object.Parent=parent
  entry={Object=object,Values={},Gui=object:IsA("GuiObject"),Stroke=class=="UIStroke",Motion={}}
  list[index]=entry self.Entries[object]=entry table.insert(self.Objects,entry)
 end
 end
 entry.Epoch=self.Epoch
 if entry.Gui and not entry.Object.Visible then entry.Object.Visible=true
 elseif entry.Stroke and not entry.Object.Enabled then entry.Object.Enabled=true end
 entry.Active=true
 return entry.Object
end
function Pool:Props(object,props,identity)
 local entry=self.Entries[object]
 local animate=self.CanAnimate and identity~=nil and identity==entry.Identity
 if identity~=entry.Identity then
  for key in pairs(entry.Motion)do entry.Values[key]=nil end
  table.clear(entry.Motion) self.Moving[entry]=nil
 end
 entry.Identity=identity
 for key,value in pairs(props)do
  if entry.Values[key]~=value then
   entry.Values[key]=value
   if animate and(key=="Position"or key=="Size")then
    entry.Motion[key]={From=object[key],To=value,Elapsed=0} self.Moving[entry]=true
   else object[key]=value end
  end
 end
end
function Pool:Step(dt)
 for entry in pairs(self.Moving)do
  for key,motion in pairs(entry.Motion)do
   motion.Elapsed=math.min(self.Duration,motion.Elapsed+dt)
   local t=motion.Elapsed/self.Duration local alpha=1-(1-t)^3
   entry.Object[key]=motion.From:Lerp(motion.To,alpha)
   if t>=1 then entry.Motion[key]=nil end
  end
  if not next(entry.Motion)then self.Moving[entry]=nil end
 end
end
function Pool:Snap()
 for entry in pairs(self.Moving)do
  for key,motion in pairs(entry.Motion)do entry.Object[key]=motion.To end
  table.clear(entry.Motion)
 end
 table.clear(self.Moving)
end
-- `thickness` (default 1 px) is centred on y. Segments are sized to stay inside the row, so the row does
-- not clip: clipping a 1 px-tall row could round to an empty rectangle and hide the whole line.
function Pool:Dash(parent,x,y,width,color,length,z,thickness)
 thickness=thickness or 1
 local row=self:Get("Frame","DashedLineRow",parent)
 self:Props(row,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y-(thickness-1)//2),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width,thickness),BackgroundTransparency=1,
  BorderSizePixel=0,ClipsDescendants=false,ZIndex=z or parent.ZIndex})
 local entry=self.Entries[row]
 -- Move a whole dash row with one property write, not hundreds of separate segments.
 if entry.Width~=width or entry.Color~=color or entry.Length~=length or entry.Z~=z or entry.T~=thickness then
  entry.Width=width entry.Color=color entry.Length=length entry.Z=z entry.T=thickness entry.Dashes=entry.Dashes or{}
  local count=math.ceil(width/(length+5))
  for i=1,math.max(count,#entry.Dashes)do
   local mark=entry.Dashes[i]
   if not mark then mark=Instance.new("Frame");mark.Name="DashedLine";mark.BorderSizePixel=0;mark.Parent=row;entry.Dashes[i]=mark end
   mark.Visible=i<=count
   if i<=count then
    local offset=(i-1)*(length+5)
    mark.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(offset,0);mark.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(length,width-offset),thickness)
    mark.BackgroundColor3=color;mark.ZIndex=z or parent.ZIndex
   end
  end
 end
 return row
end
-- Keyed objects not drawn for a long time (candles trimmed from history) are destroyed.
function Pool:Prune(age)
 local kept={}
 for _,entry in ipairs(self.Objects)do
  if entry.Keyed and not entry.Active and self.Epoch-(entry.Epoch or 0)>age then
   entry.Keyed[entry.Key]=nil self.Entries[entry.Object]=nil self.Moving[entry]=nil self.Parents[entry.Object]=nil
   entry.Object:Destroy()
  else table.insert(kept,entry) end
 end
 -- Children of destroyed objects (e.g. a hollow body's inner fill) go with them.
 local alive={}
 for _,entry in ipairs(kept)do
  if entry.Object.Parent then table.insert(alive,entry) else self.Entries[entry.Object]=nil self.Moving[entry]=nil end
 end
 self.Objects=alive
end
function Pool:Finish()
 if self.Epoch%600==0 then self:Prune(1800) end
 for _,entry in ipairs(self.Objects)do
  if entry.Epoch~=self.Epoch and entry.Active then
   if entry.Gui then entry.Object.Visible=false elseif entry.Stroke then entry.Object.Enabled=false end
   for key,motion in pairs(entry.Motion)do entry.Object[key]=motion.To end
   entry.Active=false table.clear(entry.Motion) self.Moving[entry]=nil
  end
 end
end
return Pool

local Pool=require(script.Parent.ChartPaintPool)
return function()
 local root=Instance.new("Frame") local pool=Pool.new(root)
 local ok,result=pcall(function()
  local function mark(x,identity,animate)
   pool:Begin(animate)
   local object=pool:Get("Frame","Candle",root)
   pool:Props(object,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(8,20)},identity)
   pool:Finish();return object
  end
  local candle=mark(0,60,false)
  assert(mark(0,60,true)==candle and #root:GetChildren()==1,"Unchanged paint must reuse its object")
  mark(100,60,true);assert(candle.Position.X.Offset==0,"Animation must start at the existing geometry")
  pool:Step(.02);assert(candle.Position.X.Offset>0 and candle.Position.X.Offset<100,"Intermediate geometry expected")
  pool:Step(.06);assert(candle.Position.X.Offset==100 and not next(pool.Moving),"Must settle exactly on the target")
  mark(200,60,true);pool:Step(.02)
  mark(300,120,true);assert(candle.Position.X.Offset==300,"Never animate a reused slot from a different candle")
  mark(400,120,true);pool:Step(.01);mark(450,120,false)
  assert(candle.Position.X.Offset==450 and not next(pool.Moving),"Dragging must follow the pointer without tween lag")
  mark(500,120,true);pool:Step(.01);pool:Begin(true);pool:Finish()
  assert(not candle.Visible)
  mark(500,120,true);assert(candle.Visible and candle.Position.X.Offset==500,"Hidden animation cannot resume with stale geometry")
  pool:Begin(false);local row=pool:Dash(root,0,30,600,Color3.new(1,1,1),5,3);pool:Finish()
  local count=#root:GetDescendants();local first=row:GetChildren()[1];local position=first.Position
  pool:Begin(false);local same=pool:Dash(root,0,80,600,Color3.new(1,1,1),5,3);pool:Finish()
  assert(row==same and #root:GetDescendants()==count and first.Position==position and row.Position.Y.Offset==80,"Dash movement must move only the parent")
  pool:Begin(false);pool:Dash(root,0,80,300,Color3.new(1,1,1),5,3);pool:Finish()
  local visible=0 for _,child in ipairs(row:GetChildren())do if child.Visible then visible+=1 end end
  assert(visible==30,"Resizing must hide surplus dashes")
  -- Keyed objects: a candle keeps its own object whatever order candles are drawn in.
  local keyed=Pool.new(root)
  local function draw(times)
   keyed:Begin(false) local out={}
   for _,t in ipairs(times)do out[t]=keyed:Get("Frame","KeyedCandle",root,t)end
   keyed:Finish() return out
  end
  local a=draw({60,120,180}) local b=draw({120,180,240})
  assert(a[120]==b[120] and a[180]==b[180] and b[240]~=a[60],"Keyed objects follow their identity")
  assert(not a[60].Visible and b[240].Visible,"Keyed objects out of view are hidden")
  local c=draw({60}) assert(c[60]==a[60] and c[60].Visible,"Returning candles reuse their object")
  for _=1,5 do draw({60}) end keyed:Prune(3)
  assert(a[120].Parent==nil and c[60].Parent==root,"Long-unused keyed objects are destroyed")
  return {Passed=true,Cases=10,Checks="Reuse, intermediate motion, exact settlement, candle identity, immediate drag, hidden motion, grouped dash resizing, keyed identity, keyed hiding, pruning"}
 end)
 root:Destroy();if not ok then error(result)end;return result
end
ChartTools.luau:
-- Chart drawings: stored in time (seconds) and price, never in pixels, so they stay attached to
-- the market when the chart pans, zooms, rescales or resizes. Presentation only.
local Tools={}
Tools.Colors={"Blue","Green","Red","Muted"} -- UI Kit palette keys; resolved by the view
Tools.Opacities={0.08,0.15,0.25,0.4}
Tools.Defaults={Rect={Border="Blue",Fill="Blue",Opacity=0.15},Trend={Border="Blue"},Line={Border="Blue"}}
Tools.HitTolerance={Mouse=6,Touch=14}
Tools.HandleRadius={Mouse=8,Touch=20}
local nextId=0
function Tools.NewId() nextId+=1 return "d"..nextId.."-"..math.floor(os.clock()*1000)%100000 end
local function copy(d) local r={} for k,v in pairs(d)do r[k]=v end return r end
Tools.Copy=copy
function Tools.CopyList(list) local r={} for i,d in ipairs(list)do r[i]=copy(d)end return r end
-- Gives legacy drawings an id and style so they can be selected, edited and undone.
function Tools.Normalize(d)
 d.Id=d.Id or Tools.NewId()
 local defaults=Tools.Defaults[d.Kind] or {}
 for k,v in pairs(defaults)do if d[k]==nil then d[k]=v end end
 return d
end
function Tools.New(kind,a,b,contract,timeframe)
 local d={Kind=kind,Contract=contract,Timeframe=timeframe,T1=a.Time,P1=a.Price}
 if kind~="Line" then d.T2=b.Time d.P2=b.Price end
 return Tools.Normalize(d)
end
-- Rectangle corners: 1=(T1,P1) 2=(T2,P1) 3=(T2,P2) 4=(T1,P2).
local cornerFields={{"T1","P1"},{"T2","P1"},{"T2","P2"},{"T1","P2"}}
Tools.CornerFields=cornerFields
function Tools.Points(d)
 if d.Kind=="Rect" then
  local pts={} for i,f in ipairs(cornerFields)do pts[i]={Time=d[f[1]],Price=d[f[2]],Part="Corner"..i} end return pts
 elseif d.Kind=="Trend" then return {{Time=d.T1,Price=d.P1,Part="P1"},{Time=d.T2,Price=d.P2,Part="P2"}}
 end
 return {}
end
-- A rectangle's extension handle: the midpoint of its right edge, in the caller's pixel space.
function Tools.ExtendPoint(d,toX,toY)
 return math.max(toX(d.T1),toX(d.T2)),(toY(d.P1)+toY(d.P2))/2
end
-- Strong magnet: nearest candle open/high/low/close anywhere in screen space.
-- toX/toY map time/price to pixels in the same space as x,y.
function Tools.Snap(candles,toX,toY,x,y)
 local best,bestD=nil,math.huge
 for _,c in ipairs(candles)do
  local cx=toX(c.Time)
  if (cx-x)^2<=bestD then
   for _,field in ipairs({"Open","High","Low","Close"})do
    local cy=toY(c[field]) local d=(cx-x)^2+(cy-y)^2
    if d<=bestD then best={Time=c.Time,Price=c[field],Field=field,X=cx,Y=cy} bestD=d end
   end
  end
 end
 return best
end
local function segmentDistance(px,py,x1,y1,x2,y2)
 local dx,dy=x2-x1,y2-y1 local len=dx*dx+dy*dy
 local t=len>0 and math.clamp(((px-x1)*dx+(py-y1)*dy)/len,0,1) or 0
 local qx,qy=x1+t*dx,y1+t*dy return math.sqrt((px-qx)^2+(py-qy)^2)
end
Tools.SegmentDistance=segmentDistance
-- Pixel-space soft price magnet for the selected candle, stable at every zoom level.
function Tools.SoftSnap(candle,toY,y,previous,threshold)
 if not candle then return nil end
 local limit=threshold or 7;local best,distance
 for _,field in ipairs({"Open","Close","High","Low"})do
  local d=math.abs(toY(candle[field])-y)
  if not distance or d<distance then best=field;distance=d end
 end
 if previous and previous.Time==candle.Time then
  local held=math.abs(toY(candle[previous.Field])-y)
  if held<=limit+3 and (distance>limit or held<=distance+1)then best=previous.Field;distance=held;limit+=3 end
 end
 if distance<=limit then return {Time=candle.Time,Price=candle[best],Field=best}end
end
function Tools.NearestCandle(candles,toX,x)
 local best,distance
 for _,c in ipairs(candles)do local d=math.abs(toX(c.Time)-x)
  if not distance or d<distance then best=c;distance=d end
 end
 return best
end
function Tools.ProtectionField(direction,entry,price)
 local delta=(price-entry)*direction
 return delta<0 and "Stop" or delta>0 and "Target" or nil
end
-- Returns {Drawing,Part,Interior} for the topmost drawing under the pointer.
-- The selected rectangle has an "Extend" dot at the midpoint of its right edge (checked first, slightly tighter
-- than corner handles so a small rectangle's corners stay reachable). Other handles belong to the
-- selected drawing only. A rectangle's body is "Slide" (horizontal move).
-- Interiors of unselected rectangles are flagged Interior: the view decides whether a drag there
-- moves the rectangle (mouse) or pans the chart (touch, where rectangles cover a small plot).
function Tools.HitTest(drawings,toX,toY,x,y,tolerance,handleRadius,selectedId,width)
 local extendRadius=math.max(4,handleRadius-2)
 for i=#drawings,1,-1 do
  local d=drawings[i]
  if d.Kind=="Rect" and d.Id==selectedId then
   local ex,ey=Tools.ExtendPoint(d,toX,toY)
   if math.abs(ex-x)<=extendRadius and math.abs(ey-y)<=extendRadius then return {Drawing=d,Part="Extend"} end
  end
 end
 for i=#drawings,1,-1 do
  local d=drawings[i]
  if d.Id==selectedId then
   for _,pt in ipairs(Tools.Points(d))do
    local hx,hy=toX(pt.Time),toY(pt.Price)
    if math.abs(hx-x)<=handleRadius and math.abs(hy-y)<=handleRadius then return {Drawing=d,Part=pt.Part} end
   end
  end
 end
 local interior
 for i=#drawings,1,-1 do
  local d=drawings[i]
  if d.Kind=="Line" then
   if math.abs(toY(d.P1)-y)<=tolerance and x>=0 and x<=(width or math.huge) then return {Drawing=d,Part="Move"} end
  elseif d.Kind=="Trend" then
   if segmentDistance(x,y,toX(d.T1),toY(d.P1),toX(d.T2),toY(d.P2))<=tolerance then return {Drawing=d,Part="Move"} end
  elseif d.Kind=="Rect" then
   local x1,x2=math.min(toX(d.T1),toX(d.T2)),math.max(toX(d.T1),toX(d.T2))
   local y1,y2=math.min(toY(d.P1),toY(d.P2)),math.max(toY(d.P1),toY(d.P2))
   local inside=x>=x1-tolerance and x<=x2+tolerance and y>=y1-tolerance and y<=y2+tolerance
   if inside then
    local edge=math.abs(x-x1)<=tolerance or math.abs(x-x2)<=tolerance or math.abs(y-y1)<=tolerance or math.abs(y-y2)<=tolerance
    if edge or d.Id==selectedId then return {Drawing=d,Part="Slide"} end
    interior=interior or {Drawing=d,Part="Slide",Interior=true}
   end
  end
 end
 return interior
end
-- Applies an edit to `target` from its unmodified `original`.
function Tools.Edit(target,original,part,point,delta)
 for k,v in pairs(original)do target[k]=v end
 if part=="Move" then
  target.T1=original.T1 and original.T1+delta.Time target.P1=original.P1+delta.Price
  if original.T2 then target.T2=original.T2+delta.Time target.P2=original.P2+delta.Price end
 elseif part=="Extend" then
  -- Right edge only: the left edge and both price levels stay fixed; the edge never crosses the left
  -- edge (it keeps at least delta.MinWidth seconds, one candle, of width).
  local right=(original.T2 or original.T1)>=original.T1 and "T2" or "T1" local left=right=="T2" and "T1" or "T2"
  target[right]=math.max(point.Time,original[left]+(delta and delta.MinWidth or 0))
 elseif part=="Slide" then
  -- Horizontal only: width (T2-T1), height and both price levels stay exactly as they were.
  target.T1=original.T1+delta.Time if original.T2 then target.T2=original.T2+delta.Time end
 elseif part=="P1" or part=="P2" then
  local n=part:sub(2) target["T"..n]=point.Time target["P"..n]=point.Price
 else
  local index=tonumber(part:match("Corner(%d)"))
  if index then
   local f=cornerFields[index] target[f[1]]=point.Time target[f[2]]=point.Price
  end
 end
end
-- Liang-Barsky clip to [0,w]x[0,h]. Rotated GUI objects are not clipped by ClipsDescendants.
function Tools.ClipSegment(x1,y1,x2,y2,w,h)
 local t0,t1=0,1 local dx,dy=x2-x1,y2-y1
 for _,edge in ipairs({{-dx,x1},{dx,w-x1},{-dy,y1},{dy,h-y1}})do
  local p,q=edge[1],edge[2]
  if p==0 then if q<0 then return nil end
  else
   local r=q/p
   if p<0 then if r>t1 then return nil elseif r>t0 then t0=r end
   else if r<t0 then return nil elseif r<t1 then t1=r end end
  end
 end
 return x1+t0*dx,y1+t0*dy,x1+t1*dx,y1+t1*dy
end
-- Undo/redo of the whole drawing list (small, so snapshots are simple and exact).
local History={} History.__index=History
function Tools.History(limit) return setmetatable({Past={},Future={},Limit=limit or 100},History) end
function History:Record(list)
 table.insert(self.Past,Tools.CopyList(list)) if #self.Past>self.Limit then table.remove(self.Past,1) end
 table.clear(self.Future)
end
local function restore(list,snapshot) table.clear(list) for i,d in ipairs(snapshot)do list[i]=copy(d) end end
-- Records a snapshot taken before an edit that has already been applied (e.g. a finished drag).
function History:Push(snapshot)
 table.insert(self.Past,snapshot) if #self.Past>self.Limit then table.remove(self.Past,1) end
 table.clear(self.Future)
end
function History:Undo(list)
 local snapshot=table.remove(self.Past) if not snapshot then return false end
 table.insert(self.Future,Tools.CopyList(list)) restore(list,snapshot) return true
end
function History:Redo(list)
 local snapshot=table.remove(self.Future) if not snapshot then return false end
 table.insert(self.Past,Tools.CopyList(list)) restore(list,snapshot) return true
end
function History:CanUndo() return #self.Past>0 end
function History:CanRedo() return #self.Future>0 end
-- Candle direction from exact tick counts: 1 up, -1 down, 0 doji. Independent of the viewport.
function Tools.Direction(candle,tick)
 local o=math.round(candle.Open/tick) local c=math.round(candle.Close/tick)
 return c>o and 1 or c<o and -1 or 0
end
return Tools
ChartToolsTests.luau:
local T=require(script.Parent.ChartTools)

return function()

 local checks=0

 local function check(ok,message) checks+=1 assert(ok,message) end

 -- A simple linear transform stands in for the chart: 10 px per minute, 4 px per point.

 local function view(left,high) return function(t)return math.floor((t-left)/6+0.5)end,function(p)return math.floor((high-p)*4+0.5)end end

 local X,Y=view(0,120)

 local candles={{Time=600,Open=100,High=110,Low=95,Close=105},{Time=660,Open=105,High=108,Low=101,Close=101}}

 local snap=T.Snap(candles,X,Y,X(600)+3,Y(110)+4)

 check(snap and snap.Field=="High" and snap.Price==110 and snap.Time==600,"Snaps to the nearest OHLC point")

 local far=T.Snap(candles,X,Y,900,-300)
 check(far and far.Time==660,"Strong snap has no distance limit, including future space")
 check(T.Snap({},X,Y,900,-300)==nil,"No candles leaves snapping empty")
 for _,field in ipairs({"Open","High","Low","Close"})do
  local hit=T.Snap({candles[1]},X,Y,X(600),Y(candles[1][field]))
  check(hit and hit.Price==candles[1][field],"Every OHLC target: "..field)
 end
 local pixels=T.Snap({{Time=0,Open=0,High=0,Low=0,Close=0},{Time=100,Open=90,High=90,Low=90,Close=90}},function(t)return t end,function(p)return p end,0,90)
 check(pixels.Time==0,"Screen-space distance beats price-only distance")
 pixels=T.Snap({{Time=0,Open=0,High=0,Low=0,Close=0},{Time=10,Open=90,High=90,Low=90,Close=90}},function(t)return t end,function(p)return p end,0,90)
 check(pixels.Time==10,"Screen-space distance beats nearest candle in time")

 local close=T.Snap(candles,X,Y,X(660),Y(101)+2) check(close.Price==101,"Snaps to close/low")

 -- Rectangles: stored in time/price, hit-tested in pixels at any zoom.

 local r=T.New("Rect",{Time=600,Price=110},{Time=720,Price=100},"BX","1m")

 check(r.Id and r.Border=="Blue" and r.Opacity==0.15,"Defaults")

 local list={r}

 local inside=T.HitTest(list,X,Y,X(660),Y(105),6,8,nil,1000)

 check(inside.Interior and inside.Part=="Slide","Interior of an unselected rectangle is flagged (the view chooses grab or pan)")

 check(T.HitTest(list,X,Y,X(660),Y(105),6,8,r.Id,1000).Part=="Slide","Interior of the selected rectangle slides it")

 check(T.HitTest(list,X,Y,X(600),Y(105),6,8,nil,1000).Part=="Slide","Edge selects/slides")

 check(T.HitTest(list,X,Y,X(720)+3,Y(100)-2,6,8,r.Id,1000).Part=="Corner3","Corner handle")

 check(T.HitTest(list,X,Y,X(900),Y(50),6,8,r.Id,1000)==nil,"Empty space pans")

 local X2,Y2=view(300,140) -- panned and rescaled chart: same drawing, new pixels

 check(T.HitTest(list,X2,Y2,X2(720),Y2(100),6,8,r.Id,1000).Part=="Corner3","Anchors follow the chart after panning")

 local original=T.Copy(r)

 T.Edit(r,original,"Move",nil,{Time=60,Price=2})

 check(r.T1==660 and r.T2==780 and r.P1==112 and r.P2==102,"Move shifts both anchors")

 T.Edit(r,original,"Slide",nil,{Time=-90,Price=7})

 check(r.T1==510 and r.T2==630 and r.P1==110 and r.P2==100,"Slide moves horizontally only: width, height and prices kept")

 T.Edit(r,original,"Slide",nil,{Time=240,Price=0})

 check(r.T2-r.T1==original.T2-original.T1 and r.P1==original.P1 and r.P2==original.P2 and r.T1==840,"Slide right keeps size")

 -- Right-edge extension handle: midpoint of the right edge, extends width only.

 local ext=T.Copy(original) local elist={ext}

 local ex,ey=T.ExtendPoint(ext,X,Y) check(ex==X(720) and ey==(Y(110)+Y(100))/2,"Extension handle sits at the right-edge midpoint")

 check(T.HitTest(elist,X,Y,ex+2,ey-1,6,8,nil,1000).Part=="Slide","Unselected rectangle has no extension hit area")

 check(T.HitTest(elist,X,Y,ex,Y(100)+2,6,8,ext.Id,1000).Part=="Corner3","Corner still reachable next to the extension handle")

 check(T.HitTest(elist,X,Y,ex+2,ey-1,6,8,ext.Id,1000).Part=="Extend","Selected rectangle extension is hittable")

 local copyR=T.Copy(original)

 T.Edit(copyR,original,"Extend",{Time=900,Price=90},{Time=180,Price=-20,MinWidth=60})

 check(copyR.T1==600 and copyR.T2==900 and copyR.P1==110 and copyR.P2==100,"Extend moves only the right edge: left edge and prices fixed")

 T.Edit(copyR,original,"Extend",{Time=300,Price=90},{MinWidth=60})

 check(copyR.T1==600 and copyR.T2==660,"Extend never crosses the left edge (one-candle minimum)")

 local flipped=T.Copy(original) flipped.T1,flipped.T2=original.T2,original.T1 local flippedOriginal=T.Copy(flipped)

 T.Edit(flipped,flippedOriginal,"Extend",{Time=840,Price=0},{MinWidth=60})

 check(flipped.T1==840 and flipped.T2==600 and flipped.P1==110,"Extend works whichever corner the rectangle was drawn from")

 T.Edit(r,original,"Corner1",{Time=540,Price=115})

 check(r.T1==540 and r.P1==115 and r.T2==720 and r.P2==100,"Corner resize keeps the opposite corner")

 local trend=T.New("Trend",{Time=0,Price=100},{Time=600,Price=110},"BX","1m")

 check(T.HitTest({trend},X,Y,X(300),Y(105),6,8,nil,1000).Drawing==trend,"Trend hit")

 local line=T.New("Line",{Time=0,Price=104},nil,"BX","1m")

 check(T.HitTest({line},X,Y,50,Y(104)+2,6,8,nil,1000).Drawing==line,"Horizontal line hit")

 -- Clipping keeps rotated trend lines inside the plot.

 local ax,ay,bx,by=T.ClipSegment(-50,50,150,50,100,100) check(ax==0 and bx==100 and ay==50,"Clip horizontal")

 check(T.ClipSegment(-10,-10,-5,-5,100,100)==nil,"Clip outside")

 -- Undo/redo restores exact drawing lists.

 local h=T.History(3) local drawings={}

 h:Record(drawings) table.insert(drawings,T.Copy(r))

 local before=T.CopyList(drawings) drawings[1].P1=200 h:Push(before)

 check(h:Undo(drawings) and drawings[1].P1==115,"Undo edit")

 check(h:Undo(drawings) and #drawings==0,"Undo create")

 check(not h:Undo(drawings),"Nothing more to undo")

 check(h:Redo(drawings) and #drawings==1 and h:Redo(drawings) and drawings[1].P1==200,"Redo")

 h:Record(drawings) check(not h:CanRedo(),"A new edit clears redo")

 for _=1,10 do h:Record(drawings) end check(#h.Past==3,"History is bounded")

 -- Direction uses exact tick counts, so float noise can never flip a candle's colour.

 check(T.Direction({Open=2218.4,Close=2218.4000000001},0.1)==0,"Doji")

 check(T.Direction({Open=2218.3,Close=2218.4},0.1)==1 and T.Direction({Open=5824.75,Close=5824.5},0.25)==-1,"Up/down")

 return {Passed=true,Cases=checks,Checks="Magnet snapping, rectangle/trend/line hit tests, anchoring after pan, move/slide/extend/resize, clipping, undo/redo, direction"}

end
ChartView.luau:
-- Candlestick chart: painting, navigation and drawing tools. Presentation only: it reads candles,
-- quotes and positions from the session and never changes prices or account state, except that a
-- stop/target drag sends the same AmendProtection request the order ticket uses, and the right-click
-- order menu submits through the terminal's shared order path (same checks and server validation).
local Viewport=require(script.Parent.ChartViewport)
local Timeframes=require(script.Parent.ChartTimeframes)
local PaintPool=require(script.Parent.ChartPaintPool)
local Tools=require(script.Parent.ChartTools)
local UIS=game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local TextService=game:GetService("TextService")
-- Cache by number format so quote changes do not make the axis width jitter.
local axisWidths={}
local function axisTextWidth(label,size,font)
 local pattern=label:gsub("%d","0") local key=font.Name..":"..size..":"..pattern
 local width=axisWidths[key]
 if not width then
  width=0
  for digit=0,9 do
   local sample=pattern:gsub("0",tostring(digit))
   width=math.max(width,TextService:GetTextSize(sample,size,font,Vector2.new(2000,24)).X)
  end
  axisWidths[key]=math.ceil(width)
 end
 return axisWidths[key]
end
local View={} View.__index=View
local MB1,MB2,MB3,TOUCH,MOVE=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1,Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2,Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3,Enum.UserInputType.Touch,Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
local RIGHT,CENTER=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
local DRAW={Line=true,Trend=true,Rect=true}
-- Reused native materials: bevels disappear at dense zoom levels without adding image assets.
local CANDLE_LIGHT=ColorSequence.new({
 ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)),
 ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.35,Color3.fromRGB(232,255,247)),
 ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,Color3.fromRGB(137,175,192)),
})
local CANDLE_INK=Color3.fromRGB(1,14,40)
local CANDLE_GLEAM=Color3.fromRGB(220,255,247)
local CURSOR={Hand="rbxasset://SystemCursors/OpenHand",Grab="rbxasset://SystemCursors/ClosedHand",Cross="rbxasset://SystemCursors/Cross",
 NS="rbxasset://SystemCursors/SizeNS",Move="rbxasset://SystemCursors/SizeAll",NWSE="rbxasset://SystemCursors/SizeNWSE",
 NESW="rbxasset://SystemCursors/SizeNESW",Point="rbxasset://SystemCursors/PointingHand",EW="rbxasset://SystemCursors/SizeEW"}
local function count(t) local n=0 for _ in pairs(t)do n+=1 end return n end
local TOOL_NAMES={Pan="Select & pan",Crosshair="Crosshair",Trend="Trend line",Line="Horizontal line",Rect="Rectangle"}
View.ToolNames=TOOL_NAMES

-- ImageGen originals and upload manifest: output/imagegen/chart-tool-icons-v1/.
-- The PNGs retain transparent padding; a 38px image draws an approximately 25px glyph.
local TOOL_IMAGES={
 Pan="rbxassetid://116288191081900",Crosshair="rbxassetid://74362312458286",
 Trend="rbxassetid://70763323599430",Line="rbxassetid://99078267753564",
 Rect="rbxassetid://93642847191922",Magnet="rbxassetid://119661898132965",
 Clear="rbxassetid://101328487416478",Delete="rbxassetid://101328487416478",
}
function View.AddToolIcon(parent,name,size)
 local asset=TOOL_IMAGES[name];if not asset then return nil end
 local icon=Instance.new("ImageLabel")
 icon.Name="ToolIcon";icon.BackgroundTransparency=1;icon.BorderSizePixel=0
 icon.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5);icon.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5)
 icon.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(size,size);icon.Image=asset
 icon.ImageColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1);icon.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit
 icon.Active=false;icon.Selectable=false;icon.ZIndex=parent.ZIndex+3;icon.Parent=parent
 return icon
end

-- Measured alpha bounds keep the generated labels at a consistent optical size without
-- changing their original PNGs. Timeframe controls display only the image artwork.
local TIMEFRAME_IMAGES={
 ["1m"]={Image="rbxassetid://99798012167473",Width=0.65311,Height=0.4067,CX=0.5012,CY=0.52392},
 ["5m"]={Image="rbxassetid://98117480331927",Width=0.6866,Height=0.39474,CX=0.5012,CY=0.51794},
 ["15m"]={Image="rbxassetid://131026004162086",Width=0.73684,Height=0.31818,CX=0.50478,CY=0.51316},
 ["1h"]={Image="rbxassetid://76925568025497",Width=0.56699,Height=0.46411,CX=0.5012,CY=0.52392},
 ["1D"]={Image="rbxassetid://112401119467136",Width=0.55981,Height=0.36124,CX=0.50478,CY=0.51316},
}
function View.AddTimeframeIcon(parent,timeframe)
 local asset=TIMEFRAME_IMAGES[Timeframes.Labels[timeframe]];if not asset then return nil end
 local side=math.min((parent.Size.X.Offset-10)/asset.Width,(parent.Size.Y.Offset-14)/asset.Height,20/asset.Height)
 local icon=Instance.new("ImageLabel")
 icon.Name="TimeframeIcon";icon.BackgroundTransparency=1;icon.BorderSizePixel=0
 icon.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
 icon.Position=UDim2.new(.5,(.5-asset.CX)*side,.5,(.5-asset.CY)*side)
 icon.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(side,side);icon.Image=asset.Image;icon.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit
 icon.Active=false;icon.Selectable=false;icon.ZIndex=parent.ZIndex+3;icon.Parent=parent
 parent.Text=""
 local label=parent:FindFirstChild("ControlLabel")
 if label then label:Destroy()end
 return icon
end

function View.new(ctx)
 local self=setmetatable({Ctx=ctx,S=ctx.State,Views={},History=Tools.History(100),Touches={},Ctrl=false,Shift=false,ModifierKeys={},
  Seen={},Mutations=0,ColorMismatches=0,PaintCount=0,PaintTotal=0,PaintMax=0,Cursor=""},View)
 self.S.Drawings=self.S.Drawings or {}
 for _,d in ipairs(self.S.Drawings)do Tools.Normalize(d)end
 self.S.Magnet=self.S.Magnet==true
 self.S.Tool=self.S.Tool or "Pan"
 if RunService:IsStudio()and ctx.Root then self:Diagnostics(ctx.Root)end
 return self
end
-- Studio-only test hook: read drawing/candle state and trigger the focus-loss and menu paths.
function View:Diagnostics(root)
 local f=root:FindFirstChild("ChartDiagnostics") or Instance.new("BindableFunction")
 f.Name="ChartDiagnostics" f.Parent=root
 f.OnInvoke=function(command)
  if command=="Drawings"then return Tools.CopyList(self.S.Drawings)
  elseif command=="Placement"then
   local p=self.Placement
   return p and {Kind=p.Kind,A=Tools.Copy(p.A),B=Tools.Copy(p.B),Waiting=p.Waiting} or nil
  elseif command=="Visible"then
   local g=self.Geometry if not g then return {} end
   local list={} for i,d in ipairs(g.Data)do list[i]={Time=d.Time,Open=d.Open,High=d.High,Low=d.Low,Close=d.Close,X=g.X(d.Time)}end return list
  elseif command=="FocusLost"then self:FocusLost() return true
  elseif command=="MenuOpened"then self:Cancel() return true
  elseif command=="OrderMenu"then
   local m=self.Menu if not m then return nil end
   return {Contract=m.Contract,Price=m.Price,Market=m.Market,Side=m.Side,Options=m.Labels,Quantity=self.S.Qty}
  elseif command=="OrderMarkers"then return self.OrderMarkers or {}
  elseif command=="State"then
   return {Ctrl=self.Ctrl,Shift=self.Shift,RectangleLockTime=self.RectangleLockTime,Magnet=self:MagnetOn(),Drag=self.Drag and self.Drag.Kind,Placement=self.Placement and self.Placement.Kind,Touches=count(self.Touches),Tool=self.S.Tool,Selected=self.Selected}
  end
  return nil
 end
end

-- Screen position -> plot-local pixels (origin at the price area's top-left).
function View:Local(pos)

end
function View:PointAt(x,y,snap,touch)
 local g=self.Geometry local v=g.View

  local hit=Tools.Snap(g.Data,g.X,g.Y,x,y)
  if hit then return {Time=hit.Time,Price=hit.Price,Snap=hit} end
 end
 -- Invert the viewport, never a candle index: empty/future space has real chart coordinates.
 return {Time=Viewport.TimeAt(v,x/g.Width),Price=self.Ctx.Market.Snap(Viewport.PriceAt(v,y/g.Height),self.S.Contract)}
end
-- Keep the lock in chart time so navigation cannot detach it from its bar.

 local rect=self.S.Tool=="Rect" or self.Drag and self.Drag.Kind=="Edit" and self.Drag.Target.Kind=="Rect"

 local g=self.Geometry

  local c=Tools.NearestCandle(g.Data,g.X,x)
  self.RectangleLockTime=c and c.Time or Viewport.TimeAt(g.View,x/g.Width)

end
-- One endpoint conversion for hover, drag, second click and modifier changes.

  local pt=self:PointAt(x,y,false,touch)

  pt.Price=p.A.Price

-- A whole-shape drag snaps its grabbed anchor, preserving the initial grab offset and shape size.
function View:DrawingPointAt(x,y,touch)

 if d and d.Kind=="Edit" and d.Anchor then
  local raw=self:PointAt(x,y,false,touch)
  local pt={Time=d.Anchor.Time+raw.Time-d.StartPoint.Time,
   Price=d.Part=="Slide" and d.Anchor.Price or d.Anchor.Price+raw.Price-d.StartPoint.Price}
  if self:MagnetOn()then
   local hit=Tools.Snap(g.Data,g.X,g.Y,g.X(pt.Time),g.Y(pt.Price))
   if hit then return {Time=hit.Time,Price=hit.Price,Snap=hit} end

end

  local badge=frame(plot,"RectangleLockBadge",g.Left+6,g.Top+g.Height-28,196,22,C.Raised,7);ctx.round(badge,11);ctx.stroke(badge,C.Cyan)
  text(badge,"Label","Time locked · Ctrl",0,0,196,22,12,C.Text,ctx.B,CENTER,8).TextStrokeTransparency=1
 elseif (self.S.Magnet or self:CtrlDown())and not g.Mobile then
  local round,stroke=ctx.round,ctx.stroke
  -- Bottom-left of the price area, clear of the OHLC readout and the drawing style bar.
  local badge=frame(plot,"MagnetBadge",g.Left+6,g.Top+g.Height-28,196,22,C.Raised,7);round(badge,11);stroke(badge,C.Cyan)
  text(badge,"Label",self:SnapBypassed()and"Free placement · Alt"or"Magnet · Hold Alt to bypass",0,0,196,22,12,C.Text,ctx.B,CENTER,8).TextStrokeTransparency=1
 end
end

-- Cursor feedback (desktop)
function View:SetCursor(icon)
 if self.Cursor~=icon then self.Cursor=icon;pcall(function()UIS.MouseIcon=icon end)end
end
function View:UpdateCursor()
 if self.LastTouch or not UIS.MouseEnabled then return end
 local d=self.Drag local icon=""
 if d then
  icon=d.Kind=="Pan"and(d.Moved and CURSOR.Grab or CURSOR.Hand)or(d.Kind=="Scale"or d.Kind=="Protection"or d.Kind=="Order")and CURSOR.NS
   or d.Kind=="Edit"and((d.Part=="Slide"or d.Part=="Extend")and CURSOR.EW or d.Part=="Move"and CURSOR.Move or(d.Part=="Corner1"or d.Part=="Corner3")and CURSOR.NWSE or CURSOR.NESW)
   or CURSOR.Cross
  if d.Kind=="Edit"and d.Target.Kind=="Rect"and(d.Part=="Corner1"or d.Part=="Corner3")then
   -- Corner orientation depends on which way the rectangle is stored.
   local up=(d.Target.P1>d.Target.P2)==(d.Target.T1<d.Target.T2) icon=up and CURSOR.NWSE or CURSOR.NESW
  elseif d.Kind=="Edit"and d.Target.Kind=="Rect"and(d.Part=="Corner2"or d.Part=="Corner4")then
   local up=(d.Target.P1>d.Target.P2)==(d.Target.T1<d.Target.T2) icon=up and CURSOR.NESW or CURSOR.NWSE
  elseif d.Kind=="Edit"and d.Part~="Move"and d.Part~="Slide"and d.Part~="Extend"then icon=CURSOR.Move end
 elseif self.Hover and self.Geometry then
  local x,y=self:Local(self.Hover) local g=self.Geometry
  if y>=0 and y<=g.Height and x>=0 then
   if x>=g.Width then icon=CURSOR.NS
   elseif DRAW[self.S.Tool]then icon=CURSOR.Cross
   else
    local hit=self:Hit(x,y,false)
    local prot=false
    for _,ph in ipairs(g.ProtectionHits)do if math.abs(y-ph.Y)<=6 then prot=true end end
    local grab=hit and(not hit.Interior or hit.Part=="Slide")
    local order,part=self:OrderHit(x,y,false)
    icon=order and(part=="Cancel"and CURSOR.Point or CURSOR.NS)or prot and CURSOR.NS or grab and((hit.Part=="Slide"or hit.Part=="Extend")and CURSOR.EW or hit.Part=="Move"and CURSOR.Move or CURSOR.Point)
     or self.S.Tool=="Crosshair"and CURSOR.Cross or CURSOR.Hand
   end
  end
 end
 self:SetCursor(icon)
end

-- Input
function View:Blocked()
 local s=self.S return not self.Geometry or s.Overlay or s.Sheet or self.Ctx.Options.Preview
end
function View:WorkingOrder(id)
 for _,o in ipairs(self.Ctx.Session.Orders or {})do if o.Id==id and not o.Protection then return o end end
end
function View:OrderHit(x,y,touch)
 -- Buttons win over lines, including when two orders share a price.
 for _,m in ipairs(self.OrderMarkers or {})do
  if x>=m.X and x<=m.X+m.W and y>=m.Top and y<=m.Top+m.H then return m,x>=m.CancelX and "Cancel"or"Drag" end
 end
 for _,m in ipairs(self.OrderMarkers or {})do
  if m.Type=="Limit" and m.Y and math.abs(y-m.Y)<=(touch and 12 or 5)then return m,"Drag" end
 end
end
function View:Began(ev)
 local kind=ev.UserInputType
 -- Right-click cancels an in-progress drawing or edit (Esc is reserved for the Roblox menu in-game).
 -- Otherwise it opens the order menu at the clicked price.
 if kind==MB2 then
  if self.Drag or self.Placement or DRAW[self.S.Tool] then self:Cancel();self.Ctx.refresh() else self:OpenOrderMenu(Vector2.new(ev.Position.X,ev.Position.Y))end
  return
 end
 if kind~=MB1 and kind~=MB3 and kind~=TOUCH then return end
 if self:Blocked()then return end
 local g=self.Geometry local s=self.S local session=self.Ctx.Session
 local pos=Vector2.new(ev.Position.X,ev.Position.Y)
 self.LastTouch=kind==TOUCH
 if kind==TOUCH then
  self.Touches[ev]=pos
  if count(self.Touches)>=2 then
   local d=self.Drag
   if not d or d.Kind=="Pan"or d.Kind=="Inspect"then self:StartPinch()end
   return
  end
 end
 if self.Drag then return end
 local x,y=self:Local(pos)
 if y<0 or y>g.Height or x<0 then return end
 local base={Input=ev,Type=kind,Start=pos,View=g.View,State=g.State,Width=g.Width,Height=g.Height,Moved=false}
 local function start(kindName,extra) local d=table.clone(base) d.Kind=kindName for k,v in pairs(extra or {})do d[k]=v end self.Drag=d self.Dirty=true return d end
 -- The price axis owns gestures that start on it, even beside an SL/TP or order price tag.
 -- Choose the gesture before marker hit tests so crossing into the plot keeps scaling.
 if x>=g.Width then
  local now=os.clock() local lastTap=self.LastAxisTap
  if lastTap and now-lastTap.Time<0.4 and(lastTap.Pos-pos).Magnitude<16 then self.LastAxisTap=nil;self:AutoFit();return end
  self.LastAxisTap={Time=now,Pos=pos}
  start("Scale");return
 end
 -- X consumes the gesture and only cancels its order; it can never become a chart drag.
 if kind~=MB3 then
  local marker,part=self:OrderHit(x,y,kind==TOUCH)
  if marker then
   if self.OrderPending or self.Pending then return end
   if part=="Cancel"then
    start("CancelOrder",{Id=marker.Id,Base=session.AccountKey});return
   elseif marker.Type=="Limit"then
    start("Order",{Id=marker.Id,Key=g.Key,Contract=s.Contract,Base=session.AccountKey,Original=marker.ConfirmedPrice,Price=marker.ConfirmedPrice,Quantity=marker.Quantity});return
   end
  end
 end
 -- The position label can create or replace either protection. Its own rectangle
 -- wins over nearby protection lines so a tight stop cannot steal the gesture.
 local held=session.Positions[s.Contract]
 local entry=self.EntryMarker
 if kind~=MB3 and entry and held and not held.Triggered and not self.Pending and not self.OrderPending
  and x>=entry.X and x<=entry.X+entry.W and y>=entry.Y and y<=entry.Y+entry.H then
  start("Protection",{FromEntry=true,Creating=true,Key=g.Key,Contract=s.Contract,Base=session.AccountKey,Id=held.Id,
   Original=held.Entry,Price=held.Entry,Entry=held.Entry,Quantity=held.Quantity,Direction=held.Direction,Stop=held.Stop,Target=held.Target})
  self.Ctx.Root:SetAttribute("DraggingProtection","Create");return
 end
 -- Stop and target labels keep priority over drawing tools.
 if kind~=MB3 and held and not held.Triggered and not self.Pending then
  local chosen,distance=nil,math.huge
  for _,hit in ipairs(g.ProtectionHits)do
   local label=x<=hit.Width
   local tolerance=kind==TOUCH and(label and 22 or 14)or(label and 10 or 6)
   local d=math.abs(y-hit.Y)
   if held[hit.Field] and d<=tolerance and d<distance then chosen=hit.Field;distance=d end
  end
  if chosen then
   start("Protection",{Field=chosen,Key=g.Key,Contract=s.Contract,Base=session.AccountKey,Id=held.Id,Original=held[chosen],Price=held[chosen]})
   self.Ctx.Root:SetAttribute("DraggingProtection",chosen);return
  end
 end
 if self.Pending or self.OrderPending then return end
 if kind==MB3 then start("Pan");return end
 local tool=s.Tool
 if DRAW[tool]then
  local pt=self:PlacementPointAt(x,y,kind==TOUCH)
  if tool=="Line"then start("PlaceLine",{Point=pt});return end
  if self.Placement and self.Placement.Waiting then
   self.Placement.B=pt;self:CommitPlacement();self.Ctx.onIdle(true);return
  end
  self.Placement={Kind=tool,A=pt,B=pt};start("Place");return
 end
 if tool=="Crosshair"and kind==TOUCH then self.Hover=pos;start("Inspect");return end
 local hit=self:Hit(x,y,kind==TOUCH)
 -- With a mouse, pressing anywhere on a rectangle grabs it (selects it and slides it horizontally), so
 -- a drag on a rectangle never pans the chart. On touch an unselected interior still pans; tap to select.
 if hit and(not hit.Interior or(kind~=TOUCH and hit.Part=="Slide"))then
  local d=hit.Drawing
  start("Edit",{Part=hit.Part,Target=d,Original=Tools.Copy(d),Before=Tools.CopyList(s.Drawings),StartPoint=self:PointAt(x,y,false),SelectChanged=self.Selected~=d.Id})
  if hit.Part=="Move" or hit.Part=="Slide" then
   local anchors=Tools.Points(d)
   if d.Kind=="Line" then anchors={{Time=self.Drag.StartPoint.Time,Price=d.P1}} end
   local nearest=math.huge
   for _,pt in ipairs(anchors)do
    local dist=(g.X(pt.Time)-x)^2+(g.Y(pt.Price)-y)^2
    if dist<nearest then nearest=dist;self.Drag.Anchor=pt end
   end
  end
  self.Selected=d.Id;return
 end
 start("Pan",{Click=hit and hit.Drawing.Id or false})
end
function View:StartPinch()
 local g=self.Geometry if not g then return end
 local a,b local list={} for input,pos in pairs(self.Touches)do table.insert(list,{input,pos})end
 a,b=list[1],list[2]
 if self.Drag and self.Drag.Kind=="Pan"then self.Drag=nil end
 local mid=(a[2]+b[2])/2
 local x=(mid.X-g.Plot.AbsolutePosition.X-g.Left)/g.Width
 self.Drag={Kind="Pinch",A=a[1],B=b[1],StartDistance=math.max(20,(a[2]-b[2]).Magnitude),StartFraction=x,StartMid=mid,View=g.View,State=g.State,
  Width=g.Width,Height=g.Height,Moved=true,Type=TOUCH}
 self.Hover=nil self.Dirty=true
end
function View:UpdatePinch()
 local d=self.Drag local pa,pb=self.Touches[d.A],self.Touches[d.B]
 if not pa or not pb then return end
 local g=self.Geometry
 local mid=(pa+pb)/2 local dist=math.max(20,(pa-pb).Magnitude)
 local fraction=(mid.X-g.Plot.AbsolutePosition.X-g.Left)/d.Width
 Viewport.Pinch(d.State,d.View,d.StartFraction,fraction,d.StartDistance/dist,mid.Y-d.StartMid.Y,d.Height)
 self.Dirty=true
end
function View:Changed(ev)
 local kind=ev.UserInputType
 if kind==TOUCH and self.Touches[ev]then self.Touches[ev]=Vector2.new(ev.Position.X,ev.Position.Y)end
 if kind==MOVE then self.LastTouch=false end
 local d=self.Drag
 if not d then return end
 if d.Kind=="Pinch"then if kind==TOUCH then self:UpdatePinch()end return end
 if d.Type==TOUCH then if ev~=d.Input then return end elseif kind~=MOVE then return end
 local pos=Vector2.new(ev.Position.X,ev.Position.Y)
 local delta=pos-d.Start
 if not d.Moved and delta.Magnitude<(d.Type==TOUCH and 8 or 4)then return end
 d.Moved=true
 self.Hover=pos
 if d.Kind=="Pan"then Viewport.Pan(d.State,d.View,delta.X,delta.Y,d.Width,d.Height)
 elseif d.Kind=="Scale"then Viewport.ScalePrice(d.State,d.View,delta.Y,d.Height)
 elseif d.Kind=="Protection"or d.Kind=="Order"then
  local Market=self.Ctx.Market local tick=Market.Contracts[d.Contract].Tick
  d.Price=math.max(tick,Market.Snap(d.Original-delta.Y/d.Height*(d.View.High-d.View.Low),d.Contract))
  if d.FromEntry then
   local field=Tools.ProtectionField(d.Direction,d.Entry,d.Price)
   d.Field=field;d.ExpectedPrice=field and d[field]or nil;d.Creating=d.ExpectedPrice==nil
   self.Ctx.Root:SetAttribute("DraggingProtection",d.Field or "Unavailable")
  end
 elseif self.Geometry then
  local x,y=self:Local(pos)
  if d.Kind=="Edit"then
   local pt=self:DrawingPointAt(x,y,d.Type==TOUCH)
   local origin=d.Anchor or d.StartPoint
   local Market=self.Ctx.Market
   Tools.Edit(d.Target,d.Original,d.Part,pt,{Time=pt.Time-origin.Time,Price=pt.Snap and pt.Price-origin.Price or Market.Snap(pt.Price-origin.Price,self.S.Contract),
    MinWidth=self.Geometry.View.Interval})
  elseif d.Kind=="Place"then self.Placement.B=self:PlacementPointAt(x,y,d.Type==TOUCH)
  elseif d.Kind=="PlaceLine"then d.Point=self:PointAt(x,y,true,d.Type==TOUCH)
  end
 end
 self.Dirty=true
end
function View:Ended(ev)
 local kind=ev.UserInputType
 if kind==TOUCH then self.Touches[ev]=nil end
 local d=self.Drag if not d then return end
 if d.Kind=="Pinch"then
  if kind~=TOUCH then return end
  local remaining,pos=next(self.Touches)
  if remaining and self.Geometry then
   -- Lifting one finger continues as a one-finger pan from where it is.
   local g=self.Geometry
   self.Drag={Kind="Pan",Input=remaining,Type=TOUCH,Start=pos,View=g.View,State=g.State,Width=g.Width,Height=g.Height,Moved=true}
  else self:Finish(true)end
  return
 end
 if d.Type==TOUCH then if ev~=d.Input then return end elseif kind~=d.Type then return end
 self:Finish(ev.UserInputState~=Enum.UserInputState.Cancel)
end
function View:Finish(commit)
 local d=self.Drag if not d then return end
 self.Drag=nil
 local s=self.S local chrome=false
 self.Ctx.Root:SetAttribute("DraggingProtection",nil)
 if d.Kind=="Pan"then
  if not d.Moved and commit then
   local chosen=d.Click or nil
   if chosen~=self.Selected then self.Selected=chosen;chrome=true end
  end
  if d.Type==TOUCH then self.Hover=nil end
 elseif d.Kind=="Edit"then
  if not commit then for k in pairs(d.Target)do d.Target[k]=nil end for k,v in pairs(d.Original)do d.Target[k]=v end
  elseif d.Moved then self.History:Push(d.Before);chrome=true end
  if d.SelectChanged then chrome=true end
  if d.Type==TOUCH then self.Hover=nil end
 elseif d.Kind=="Place"then
  if not commit or not self.Placement then self.Placement=nil
  elseif d.Moved then self:CommitPlacement();chrome=true
  else self.Placement.Waiting=true end
 elseif d.Kind=="PlaceLine"then
  if commit then
   local before=Tools.CopyList(s.Drawings)
   local line=Tools.New("Line",d.Point,nil,s.Contract,s.Timeframe)
   table.insert(s.Drawings,line);self.History:Push(before);self.Selected=line.Id;s.Tool="Pan";chrome=true
  end
 elseif d.Kind=="CancelOrder"then
  if commit and not d.Moved and d.Base==self.Ctx.Session.AccountKey then
   local ok,message=self.Ctx.Session:Cancel(d.Id)
   if not ok then self.Ctx.toast(message,"error")end
  end
 elseif d.Kind=="Order"then
  if commit and d.Moved and d.Price~=d.Original then
   local ok,message,_,requestId=self.Ctx.Session:AmendOrder(d.Contract,d.Id,d.Price,d.Original,d.Quantity)
   if ok then
    d.RequestId=requestId;self.OrderPending=d
    task.delay(10,function()
     if self.OrderPending==d then self.OrderPending=nil;self.Dirty=true;self.Ctx.toast("Limit change not confirmed. Showing its last confirmed price.","error")end
    end)
   else self.Ctx.toast(message,"error")end
  end
 elseif d.Kind=="Protection"then
  if commit and d.Moved and d.Price~=d.Original and d.Field then
   local ok,message,_,requestId
   if d.Creating then ok,message,_,requestId=self.Ctx.Session:CreateProtection(d.Contract,d.Id,d.Field,d.Price,d.Quantity)
   else ok,message,_,requestId=self.Ctx.Session:AmendProtection(d.Contract,d.Id,d.Field,d.Price,d.FromEntry and d.ExpectedPrice or d.Original,d.FromEntry and d.Quantity or nil)end
   if ok then
    d.RequestId=requestId;self.Pending=d
    task.delay(10,function()
     if self.Pending==d then self.Pending=nil;self.Dirty=true;self.Ctx.toast("Change not confirmed. Showing the last confirmed price.")end
    end)
   else self.Ctx.toast(message)end
  end
 elseif d.Kind=="Inspect"then self.Hover=nil
 end
 self.Dirty=true
 self.Ctx.onIdle(chrome)
end
function View:CommitPlacement()
 local p=self.Placement self.Placement=nil
 self.RectangleLockTime=nil
 local s=self.S local g=self.Geometry
 if not p or not p.B or not g then return end
 -- Ignore a zero-size shape (a click without a second point).
 local w=math.abs(g.X(p.A.Time)-g.X(p.B.Time)) local h=math.abs(g.Y(p.A.Price)-g.Y(p.B.Price))
 if(p.Kind=="Rect"and(w<3 or h<3))or(p.Kind=="Trend"and w+h<4)then return end
 local before=Tools.CopyList(s.Drawings)
 local d=Tools.New(p.Kind,p.A,p.B,s.Contract,s.Timeframe)
 table.insert(s.Drawings,d);self.History:Push(before);self.Selected=d.Id;s.Tool="Pan"
end
function View:Wheel(ev)
 local g=self.Geometry
 if not g or self.Drag or self.Pending or self.OrderPending or self:Blocked()then return end
 local x=(ev.Position.X-g.Plot.AbsolutePosition.X-g.Left)/g.Width
 Viewport.Zoom(g.State,g.View,ev.Position.Z>0 and 0.85 or 1/0.85,x);self.Dirty=true
end
-- Returns true when the key was used by the chart.
function View:KeyBegan(ev)
 local key=ev.KeyCode
 if key==Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt or key==Enum.KeyCode.RightAlt then self:ModifierChanged();return false end
 if key==Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl or key==Enum.KeyCode.RightControl or key==Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift or key==Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
  self.ModifierKeys[key]=true
  self.Ctrl=self.ModifierKeys[Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl] or self.ModifierKeys[Enum.KeyCode.RightControl] or false
  self.Shift=self.ModifierKeys[Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift] or self.ModifierKeys[Enum.KeyCode.RightShift] or false
  self:ModifierChanged();return false
 end
 if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox()then return false end
 local ctrl=UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl)
 local shift=UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift)or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
 if key==Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
  if self.Menu then self:CloseOrderMenu();return true end
  if self.Drag or self.Placement then self:Cancel();self.Ctx.refresh();return true end
  if DRAW[self.S.Tool]then self.S.Tool="Pan";self.Ctx.refresh();return true end
  if self.Selected then self.Selected=nil;self.Ctx.refresh();return true end
  return false
 elseif(key==Enum.KeyCode.Delete or key==Enum.KeyCode.Backspace)and self:SelectedDrawing()and not self.Drag then
  self:DeleteSelected();return true
 elseif ctrl and key==Enum.KeyCode.Z and not self.Drag then if shift then self:Redo()else self:Undo()end return true
 elseif ctrl and key==Enum.KeyCode.Y and not self.Drag then self:Redo();return true
 end
 return false
end
function View:KeyEnded(ev)
 if ev.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt or ev.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.RightAlt then self:ModifierChanged() end
 local key=ev.KeyCode
 if key==Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl or key==Enum.KeyCode.RightControl or key==Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift or key==Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
  self.ModifierKeys[key]=nil
  self.Ctrl=self.ModifierKeys[Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl] or self.ModifierKeys[Enum.KeyCode.RightControl] or false
  self.Shift=self.ModifierKeys[Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift] or self.ModifierKeys[Enum.KeyCode.RightShift] or false
  self:ModifierChanged()
 end
end
-- Re-evaluate an active drag when the modifier changes, even without mouse motion.
function View:ModifierChanged()
 self:UpdateRectangleLock()
 self.Dirty=true
 local d=self.Drag
 if d and d.Moved and d.Type~=TOUCH and self.Hover then
  self:Changed({UserInputType=MOVE,Position=self.Hover})
 elseif self.Placement and self.Placement.Waiting and self.Hover then
  local x,y=self:Local(self.Hover)
  self.Placement.B=self:PlacementPointAt(x,y,self.LastTouch)
 end
end
-- Cancels the current gesture: an edit restores the drawing, a placement is discarded.
function View:Cancel()
 if self.Drag then self:Finish(false)end
 self.Placement=nil self.RectangleLockTime=nil self.Hover=nil self.Dirty=true
 if DRAW[self.S.Tool] then self.S.Tool="Pan" end
end
-- Window focus lost (or the Roblox menu opened): cancel any gesture and clear modifier state.
function View:FocusLost()
 self:CloseOrderMenu()
 self.Ctrl=false self.Shift=false table.clear(self.ModifierKeys) table.clear(self.Touches)
 self:Cancel()
 self.Hover=nil self.Dirty=true self:SetCursor("")
end
function View:Step(dt)
 local g=self.Geometry
 if g and Viewport.Ease(g.State,dt,self.Drag and(self.Drag.Kind=="Protection"or self.Drag.Kind=="Order"))then self.Dirty=true end
end
function View:OnMarketUpdate()
 self:UpdateOrderMenu()
 local session=self.Ctx.Session local d=self.Drag
 local message
 if d and d.Kind=="Protection"then
  local held=session.Positions[d.Contract]
  if session.AccountKey~=d.Base or not held or held.Id~=d.Id or held.Triggered
   or d.FromEntry and (held.Quantity~=d.Quantity or held.Entry~=d.Entry or held.Stop~=d.Stop or held.Target~=d.Target)
   or not d.FromEntry and held[d.Field]~=d.Original then
   self:Finish(false);message="Position or protection changed. Drag cancelled."
  end
 end
 if d and d.Kind=="Order"then
  local o=self:WorkingOrder(d.Id)
  if session.AccountKey~=d.Base or not o or o.Price~=d.Original or o.Quantity~=d.Quantity then
   self:Finish(false);message="Limit order changed or filled. Drag cancelled."
  end
 end
 if self.OrderPending then
  local p=self.OrderPending
  if p.Base~=session.AccountKey or not self:WorkingOrder(p.Id)then self.OrderPending=nil end
 end
 local pending=self.Pending
 if pending then
  local held=session.Positions[pending.Contract]
  if session.AccountKey~=pending.Base or not held or held.Id~=pending.Id or held.Triggered or not pending.Creating and not held[pending.Field]then self.Pending=nil end
 end
 self.Dirty=true
 return message
end
function View:OnReply(reply)
 if self.OrderPending and reply.RequestId==self.OrderPending.RequestId then self.OrderPending=nil;self.Dirty=true end
 if self.Pending and reply.RequestId==self.Pending.RequestId then self.Pending=nil;self.Dirty=true end
end

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Right-click order menu. The clicked price becomes the order price; the choices depend on where it
-- sits relative to the last traded price: above -> Limit Sell / Stop Buy, below -> Limit Buy / Stop Sell.
-- It shows only those two actions with their price. The quantity is the one selected in Place a Trade
-- (one shared state), and submission uses the terminal's shared order path (same client checks, SL/TP
-- settings, pending state and toasts); the server validates exactly as for the ticket.
local MENU_W,MENU_ROW,MENU_PAD=236,42,8
function View:MenuOptions(price,last)
 if price>last then
  return "Above",{{Dir=-1,Type="Limit",Title="Limit Sell",Gloss="Red"},{Dir=1,Type="Stop",Title="Stop Buy",Gloss="Green"}}
 elseif price<last then
  return "Below",{{Dir=1,Type="Limit",Title="Limit Buy",Gloss="Green"},{Dir=-1,Type="Stop",Title="Stop Sell",Gloss="Red"}}
 end
 return "At",{}
end
function View:OpenOrderMenu(pos)
 self:CloseOrderMenu()
 local ctx=self.Ctx
 if self:Blocked() or not ctx.submitOrder then return false end
 local g=self.Geometry local x,y=self:Local(pos)
 if x<0 or x>g.Width or y<0 or y>g.Height then return false end
 local s=self.S local Market=ctx.Market
 local price=Market.Snap(g.View.High-y/g.Ppp,s.Contract)

-- Presentation-only chart navigation. Never modifies prices, candles or account state.
-- Time is horizontal (seconds), price is vertical. All inputs are screen deltas in pixels.
local Viewport={}
Viewport.Seconds={["1m"]=60,["5m"]=300,["15m"]=900,["1h"]=3600,["1D"]=86400}
Viewport.MinBars=10          -- deepest zoom-in
Viewport.MaxBars=240        -- absolute zoom-out ceiling (render budget)
Viewport.PixelsPerBar=7      -- readable 3+ px bodies, distinct wicks and space between candles
Viewport.RightMargin=3       -- empty bars to the right of the live candle
Viewport.EaseSeconds=0.07    -- auto-fit price-scale smoothing
Viewport.DefaultBars={Desktop=72,Mobile=36}

-- Practical zoom range: limited by the available history and by how many candles the plot can draw.
function Viewport.Limits(count,width)
 local render=math.clamp(math.floor((width or 800)/Viewport.PixelsPerBar),Viewport.MinBars+10,Viewport.MaxBars)
 local data=math.max(40,math.ceil(count*1.15)+Viewport.RightMargin+2)
 return Viewport.MinBars,math.max(Viewport.MinBars+2,math.min(render,data))
end
-- First index whose candle time is >= time (binary search; candles are time ordered).
local function lowerBound(candles,time)
 local lo,hi=1,#candles+1
 while lo<hi do local mid=(lo+hi)//2 if candles[mid].Time<time then lo=mid+1 else hi=mid end end
 return lo
end
Viewport.LowerBound=lowerBound

function Viewport.Resolve(state,candles,timeframe,tick,mobile,levels,width)
 if #candles==0 then return nil end
 local interval=Viewport.Seconds[timeframe]
 local minBars,maxBars=Viewport.Limits(#candles,width)
 state.Bars=math.clamp(state.Bars or (mobile and Viewport.DefaultBars.Mobile or Viewport.DefaultBars.Desktop),minBars,maxBars)
 state.Interval=interval
 local latest,earliest=candles[#candles].Time,candles[1].Time
 if state.Right==nil then state.Right=latest+Viewport.RightMargin*interval state.Follow=true end
 -- Following: new candles scroll the view by exactly the time they add. Detached: the view never moves.
 if state.Follow and state.Latest and latest~=state.Latest then state.Right+=latest-state.Latest end
 state.Latest=latest
 local maximum=latest+state.Bars*0.8*interval
 local minimum=math.min(earliest+math.min(6,state.Bars*0.5)*interval,maximum)
 state.Right=math.clamp(state.Right,minimum,maximum)
 local right=state.Right local left=right-state.Bars*interval
 -- One extra candle each side so partially visible bodies are drawn and clipped, not popped.
 local first=lowerBound(candles,left-interval) local last=lowerBound(candles,right+interval)-1
 local visible=table.move(candles,first,math.max(first-1,last),1,{})
 local low,high=math.huge,-math.huge
 for _,c in ipairs(visible)do
  if c.Time>=left-interval*0.5 and c.Time<=right+interval*0.5 then low=math.min(low,c.Low) high=math.max(high,c.High) end
 end
 if low==math.huge then local c=candles[math.clamp(first,1,#candles)] low=c.Low high=c.High end
 -- While following, keep the live price and the open position's levels in view.
 if state.Follow then for _,price in ipairs(levels or {})do low=math.min(low,price) high=math.max(high,price) end end
 local padding=math.max(tick*2,(high-low)*0.08)
 local targetLow,targetHigh=low-padding,high+padding
 state.TargetLow,state.TargetHigh=targetLow,targetHigh
 local auto=state.AutoY~=false
 local lo,hi
 if auto then
  if not state.ShowLow then state.ShowLow,state.ShowHigh=targetLow,targetHigh end
  lo,hi=state.ShowLow,state.ShowHigh
 else lo,hi=state.Low,state.High end
 if hi-lo<tick then local mid=(lo+hi)/2 lo,hi=mid-tick/2,mid+tick/2 end
 return {Left=left,Right=right,Low=lo,High=hi,Bars=state.Bars,Interval=interval,Data=visible,First=first,
  Earliest=earliest,Latest=latest,Minimum=minimum,Maximum=maximum,MinBars=minBars,MaxBars=maxBars,Tick=tick,
  Follow=state.Follow==true,AutoY=auto,TargetLow=targetLow,TargetHigh=targetHigh,
  Live=state.Follow==true and auto}
end
-- Eases the displayed auto-fit range toward its target. Returns true while still moving.
function Viewport.Ease(state,dt,snap)
 if state.AutoY==false or not state.TargetLow then return false end
 if snap or not state.ShowLow then state.ShowLow,state.ShowHigh=state.TargetLow,state.TargetHigh return false end
 local range=math.max(1e-9,state.TargetHigh-state.TargetLow)
 local dl,dh=state.TargetLow-state.ShowLow,state.TargetHigh-state.ShowHigh
 if math.abs(dl)<range*0.0005 and math.abs(dh)<range*0.0005 then
  state.ShowLow,state.ShowHigh=state.TargetLow,state.TargetHigh return false
 end
 local k=1-math.exp(-math.max(0,dt)/Viewport.EaseSeconds)
 state.ShowLow+=dl*k state.ShowHigh+=dh*k
 return true
end
function Viewport.TimeAt(view,fraction) return view.Left+(view.Right-view.Left)*fraction end
function Viewport.PriceAt(view,fraction) return view.High-(view.High-view.Low)*fraction end
function Viewport.X(view,time,width) return (time-view.Left)/(view.Right-view.Left)*width end
function Viewport.Y(view,price,height) return (view.High-price)/(view.High-view.Low)*height end
local function refollow(state)
 if state.Latest and state.Interval then state.Follow=state.Right>=state.Latest+state.Interval*0.5 end
end
-- Manual price scale: fix the current range so later changes are explicit.
local function manual(state,view)
 if state.AutoY~=false then state.AutoY=false state.Low,state.High=view.Low,view.High end
end
function Viewport.Pan(state,start,dx,dy,width,height)
 state.Right=math.clamp(start.Right-dx/math.max(1,width)*(start.Right-start.Left),math.min(start.Minimum,start.Maximum),start.Maximum)
 -- Auto-fit keeps the price axis fitted to the candles; a manual scale pans vertically with the pointer.
 if not start.AutoY then
  local shift=dy/math.max(1,height)*(start.High-start.Low)
  state.Low=start.Low+shift state.High=start.High+shift
 end
 refollow(state)
end
function Viewport.Zoom(state,view,factor,fraction)
 fraction=math.clamp(fraction,0,1)
 local bars=math.clamp(view.Bars*factor,view.MinBars or Viewport.MinBars,view.MaxBars or Viewport.MaxBars)
 local anchor=Viewport.TimeAt(view,fraction)
 state.Bars=bars state.Right=anchor+(1-fraction)*bars*view.Interval
 -- Zooming out reveals more history, not empty future: the right edge never moves past where it was
 -- (or the live candle's usual margin), so the extra room goes to older candles.
 if bars>view.Bars and view.Latest and view.Interval then
  state.Right=math.min(state.Right,math.max(view.Right,view.Latest+Viewport.RightMargin*view.Interval))
 end
 refollow(state)
end
-- Two-finger gesture: the time under the starting midpoint stays under the current midpoint.
function Viewport.Pinch(state,start,fromFraction,toFraction,ratio,dy,height)
 local bars=math.clamp(start.Bars*ratio,start.MinBars or Viewport.MinBars,start.MaxBars or Viewport.MaxBars)
 local anchor=Viewport.TimeAt(start,math.clamp(fromFraction,0,1))
 state.Bars=bars state.Right=anchor+(1-toFraction)*bars*start.Interval
 if not start.AutoY and dy then
  local shift=dy/math.max(1,height)*(start.High-start.Low)
  state.Low=start.Low+shift state.High=start.High+shift
 end
 refollow(state)
end
-- Y-axis drag: down expands the visible price range (candles shorter), up compresses it (taller).
function Viewport.ScalePrice(state,start,dy,height)
 local factor=math.exp(math.clamp(dy,-2000,2000)/math.max(120,height)*1.6)
 local mid=(start.Low+start.High)/2
 local half=math.clamp((start.High-start.Low)/2*factor,(start.Tick or 0.01)*2,math.max(1,math.abs(mid))*2)
 state.AutoY=false state.Low=mid-half state.High=mid+half
end
function Viewport.AutoFit(state)
 if state.AutoY==false and state.Low then state.ShowLow,state.ShowHigh=state.Low,state.High end
 state.AutoY=true state.Low=nil state.High=nil
end
-- Follow the live candle again at the current zoom. A manual scale is re-centred on the live price.
function Viewport.GoLive(state,price)
 if state.AutoY==false and state.Low and price then
  local half=(state.High-state.Low)/2 state.Low=price-half state.High=price+half
 end
 state.Right=nil state.Follow=true
end
function Viewport.Reset(state)
 table.clear(state)
end
Viewport.Manual=manual
local niceSteps={1,2,2.5,5}
-- Round-number price grid; every label is a multiple of the contract tick.
function Viewport.PriceTicks(low,high,tick,count)
 local range=math.max(high-low,tick) local raw=range/math.max(1,count)
 local magnitude=10^math.floor(math.log10(raw)) local step
 for _,m in ipairs(niceSteps)do if m*magnitude>=raw then step=m*magnitude break end end
 step=step or 10*magnitude
 step=math.max(tick,math.ceil(step/tick-1e-9)*tick)
 local ticks={} local p=math.ceil(low/step-1e-9)*step
 while p<=high+1e-9 and #ticks<64 do table.insert(ticks,p) p+=step end
 return ticks,step
end
local timeSteps={60,120,300,600,900,1800,3600,7200,10800,14400,21600,43200,86400,172800,432000,864000,2592000}
function Viewport.TimeTicks(left,right,interval,count)
 local raw=(right-left)/math.max(1,count) local step=timeSteps[#timeSteps]
 for _,s in ipairs(timeSteps)do if s>=interval and s>=raw then step=s break end end
 local ticks={} local t=math.ceil(left/step)*step
 while t<=right and #ticks<64 do table.insert(ticks,t) t+=step end
 return ticks,step
end
return Viewport

local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
local Confetti={}
Confetti.Palette={Color3.fromRGB(46,249,160),Color3.fromRGB(255,222,40),Color3.fromRGB(0,220,255),Color3.fromRGB(190,132,255),
 Color3.fromRGB(255,120,168),Color3.fromRGB(245,249,255)}
local function sparkle(parent,x,y,size,color,z)
 local s=Instance.new("Frame");s.Name="Sparkle";s.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5);s.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y)
 s.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(size,size);s.BackgroundTransparency=1;s.ZIndex=z;s.Active=false
 for i=0,1 do
  local ray=Instance.new("Frame");ray.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5);ray.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5);ray.BorderSizePixel=0
  ray.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,.24);ray.Rotation=45+i*90;ray.BackgroundColor3=color;ray.ZIndex=z

end
Confetti.Sparkle=sparkle
-- Burst from (x, y) in the parent's offset space. opts: Count, Power, Spread (radians), Calm, ZIndex, Duration.
function Confetti.Burst(parent,x,y,opts)
 opts=opts or {}
 if not parent or not parent.Parent then return end
 local z=opts.ZIndex or 50
 if opts.Calm then
  for i=1,math.min(6,opts.Count or 6)do
   local a=(i/6)*math.pi*2
   local s=sparkle(parent,x+math.cos(a)*28,y+math.sin(a)*22,14,Confetti.Palette[(i-1)%#Confetti.Palette+1],z)
   for _,ray in ipairs(s:GetChildren())do
    ray.BackgroundTransparency=1
    local t=TweenService:Create(ray,TweenInfo.new(.35,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out,0,true),{BackgroundTransparency=0})
    t:Play()
   end
   task.delay(.8,function()s:Destroy()end)
  end
  return
 end
 local count=opts.Count or 24;local power=opts.Power or 420;local spread=opts.Spread or math.pi*.9
 local pieces={}
 for i=1,count do
  local p=Instance.new("Frame");p.Name="Confetti";p.BorderSizePixel=0;p.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5);p.Active=false;p.ZIndex=z
  local round=math.random()<.35
  p.Size=round and UDim2.fromOffset(8,8)or UDim2.fromOffset(math.random(6,10),math.random(10,15))
  p.BackgroundColor3=Confetti.Palette[math.random(#Confetti.Palette)]
  if round then local c=Instance.new("UICorner");c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(.5,0);c.Parent=p else local c=Instance.new("UICorner");c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,2);c.Parent=p end
  local angle=-math.pi/2+(math.random()-.5)*spread
  local speed=power*(.45+math.random()*.65)
  pieces[i]={F=p,X=x,Y=y,VX=math.cos(angle)*speed,VY=math.sin(angle)*speed,R=math.random(0,360),VR=math.random(-540,540),Flip=math.random()*6,W=p.Size.X.Offset,H=p.Size.Y.Offset}
  p.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y);p.Parent=parent
 end
 local life=opts.Duration or 1.25;local age=0;local connection
 connection=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
  age+=dt
  local fade=math.clamp((age-(life-.35))/.35,0,1)
  for _,q in ipairs(pieces)do
   q.VY+=980*dt;q.VX*=(1-1.6*dt);q.X+=q.VX*dt;q.Y+=q.VY*dt;q.R+=q.VR*dt
   local f=q.F;f.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(q.X,q.Y);f.Rotation=q.R;f.BackgroundTransparency=fade
   -- Flutter: the piece's width breathes as it tumbles.
   f.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(2,q.W*math.abs(math.cos(age*9+q.Flip))),q.H)
  end
  if age>=life or not parent.Parent then
   connection:Disconnect()
   for _,q in ipairs(pieces)do q.F:Destroy()end
  end
 end)
end
-- A shower across the top of the parent (the "You're ready!" moment).
function Confetti.Shower(parent,opts)
 opts=opts or {}
 if not parent or not parent.Parent then return end
 local w=parent.AbsoluteSize.X
 if opts.Calm then Confetti.Burst(parent,w/2,parent.AbsoluteSize.Y*.3,{Calm=true,ZIndex=opts.ZIndex});return end
 for i=0,2 do
  Confetti.Burst(parent,w*(.2+i*.3),parent.AbsoluteSize.Y*.42,{Count=opts.Count or 22,Power=opts.Power or 620,Spread=math.pi*.55,ZIndex=opts.ZIndex,Duration=1.6})
 end
end
return Confetti

  if force then self.NextRefresh=math.min(self.NextRefresh,now+2.2) end
  return

function View:Row(side,index)

 local color=side=="Asks"and C.Red or C.Green
 local bar=make("Frame","Liquidity",p,{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0),Position=UDim2.fromScale(1,0),Size=UDim2.fromScale(0,1),
  BackgroundColor3=color,BackgroundTransparency=.82,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=p.ZIndex})
 make("UICorner","Corners",bar,{CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,3)})
 local row={Root=p,Bar=bar,Side=label(p,"Side","",2,0,56,View.RowHeight,12,color),
  Price=label(p,"Price","",56,0,self.Width-136,View.RowHeight,14,C.Text,Enum.TextXAlignment.Right),
  Quantity=label(p,"Quantity","",self.Width-74,0,56,View.RowHeight,14,C.Text,Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)}
