end
function View:SetHeight(height)
 self.Root.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(self.Width,height);self.Body.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(self.Width,math.max(0,height-40))
 if self.Height~=height then self.Height=height;if self.Context.resize then self.Context.resize(height)end end
end
function View:Update()
 if not self.Root.Parent then return end
 local ctx=self.Context;local expanded=ctx.expanded();local access,quote,fresh=ctx.data()
 self.Root:SetAttribute("Expanded",expanded);self.Body.Visible=expanded
 self.Chevron.Text=expanded and "−"or"+"
 if not expanded then self:SetHeight(40);return end
 -- Geometry never follows the number of levels or a transient data/access state.
 self:SetHeight(40+26+self.LevelCount*View.RowHeight*2+28+8)
 local allowed=access and access.Allowed==true
 local state=access and access.State or "Checking"
 local depth=allowed and fresh and quote and quote.Depth
 local book=type(depth)=="table"
 self.Columns.Visible=book;self.Spread.Visible=book;self.ScaleLabel.Visible=book
 self.Message.Visible=not book;self.Unlock.Visible=not allowed and state~="Checking"
 local asks,bids
 if book then asks=levels(depth.Asks);bids=levels(depth.Bids)end
 local maximum=0
 for _,side in ipairs({asks or{},bids or{}})do for i=1,math.min(#side,self.LevelCount)do maximum=math.max(maximum,side[i].Quantity)end end
 -- A shared, labelled high-water scale prevents every bar breathing when one order disappears.
 -- The context retains this per instrument across other UI redraws. No quantity is fabricated.
 local scale=ctx.scale and ctx.scale()or self.Scale
 while scale<maximum do scale*=2 end
 self.Scale=scale;if ctx.scale then ctx.scale(scale)end
 self.ScaleLabel.Text="Bar max "..ctx.quantity(scale)
 local spreadY=26+self.LevelCount*View.RowHeight
 self.Spread.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,spreadY)
 local spread=asks and asks[1]and bids and bids[1]and asks[1].Price-bids[1].Price
 self.Spread.Text=spread and ("Spread  "..ctx.number(spread))or "Spread unavailable"
 for _,side in ipairs({"Asks","Bids"})do
  local data
  if side=="Asks"then data=asks else data=bids end
  local empty=self["Empty"..side]
  local top=side=="Asks"and 26 or spreadY+28
  empty.Visible=book and (not data or #data==0)
  empty.Text=not data and (side.." unavailable")or (side=="Asks"and "No resting asks"or "No resting bids")
  empty.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,top+(self.LevelCount*View.RowHeight-20)/2)
  for index=1,self.LevelCount do
   local row=self:Row(side,index);local level=data and data[index]
   local slot=side=="Asks"and self.LevelCount-index or index-1
   row.Root.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,top+slot*View.RowHeight)
   row.Root.Visible=level~=nil
   if level then
    local changedPrice=row.Root:GetAttribute("Price")~=level.Price
    row.Side.Text=index==1 and (side=="Asks"and "Best ask"or "Best bid")or ""
    row.Root:SetAttribute("Best",index==1);row.Root:SetAttribute("Price",level.Price);row.Root:SetAttribute("Quantity",level.Quantity)
    row.Price.Text=ctx.number(level.Price);row.Quantity.Text=ctx.quantity(level.Quantity)
    local ratio=level.Quantity/scale
    if row.Ratio~=ratio or changedPrice then
     if self.Tweens[row]then self.Tweens[row]:Cancel();self.Tweens[row]=nil end
     if row.Ratio==nil or changedPrice then row.Bar.Size=UDim2.fromScale(ratio,1)
     else local tween=TweenService:Create(row.Bar,TweenInfo.new(.12,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Size=UDim2.fromScale(ratio,1)});self.Tweens[row]=tween;tween:Play()end
     row.Ratio=ratio
    end
   else
    if self.Tweens[row]then self.Tweens[row]:Cancel();self.Tweens[row]=nil end
    row.Ratio=nil;row.Root:SetAttribute("Price",nil);row.Root:SetAttribute("Quantity",nil)
   end
  end
 end
 if not book then
  self.Message.Text=not allowed and (state=="Checking"and "Checking L2 access…"or state=="Unavailable"and "Access check unavailable"or "Market Depth Pro · Locked")
   or fresh==false and "Depth paused · reconnecting…"or "Loading market depth…"
  if allowed and fresh and quote and quote.Depth==nil then self.Message.Text="Market depth unavailable"end
 end
end
function View:Destroy()
 for _,tween in pairs(self.Tweens)do tween:Cancel()end
 self.Tweens={};self.Root:Destroy()
end
return View
MarketClient.luau:
-- Read-only client view. All orders and balances are owned by MarketServer.

local root=script.Parent

local Config=require(root.MarketConfig)
local Timeframes=require(root.ChartTimeframes)

local Progression=require(root.ProgressionConfig)

local Protection=require(root.TradeProtection)
local ContractLimits=require(root.ContractLimits)
local Market={DepthLevels=Config.DepthLevels or 5,Contracts=Config.Contracts,ContractOrder=Config.ContractOrder,Progression=Progression,ContractLimit=ContractLimits.ForBalance}
Market.Contracts=table.clone(Config.Contracts)

Market.PositionOrder=table.clone(Config.ContractOrder)

for _,key in ipairs(Config.LegacyOrder) do Market.Contracts[key]=Config.LegacyContracts[key];table.insert(Market.PositionOrder,key) end

function Market.Number(value)

 local raw=string.format("%.2f",math.abs(value or 0)) local whole,decimal=raw:match("^(%d+)%.(%d+)$")

 return ((value or 0)<0 and "-" or "")..whole:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)","%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,","").."."..decimal

end

function Market.Money(value) return "$"..Market.Number(value) end

function Market.Signed(value) return (value<0 and "−" or "+")..Market.Money(math.abs(value)) end

function Market.Snap(value,key) return math.round(value/Config.Contracts[key].Tick)*Config.Contracts[key].Tick end

Market.Protection=Protection.Resolve

local Session={} Session.__index=Session

function Market.New(base,preview,previewData)

 base=base or Progression.StartingBalance

 local self=setmetatable({Base=base,Prices={},Quotes={},Positions={},Orders={},History={},Fills={},Cache={},
  ProtectionPreferences=Protection.Preferences(),ClosedEvents={},ClosedEventOrder={},
  Time=0,Regime="Connecting",EventBacklog={},Speed=Config.SimulationSpeed,Ready=false,CanTrade=false,NextId=0,Pending={},Contract=Config.ContractOrder[1],Timeframe=Timeframes.Default,

  Changed=Instance.new("BindableEvent"),Replies=Instance.new("BindableEvent"),Events=Instance.new("BindableEvent"),Preview=preview},Session)

 self.SummaryData={Balance=base,Equity=base,Unrealized=0,Session=0,Allowance=Progression.StartingBalance,Count=0,Margin=0}

 for _,key in ipairs(Market.ContractOrder) do self.Prices[key]=Market.Contracts[key].Last end

 if preview then

  self.Regime="Edit preview"

  if previewData then

   -- An offline snapshot generated by the real exchange, used only to author Studio's saved GUI.

   self.Quotes=previewData.Quotes self.Cache=previewData.CandlesBySeries

   self.Time=previewData.Time self.Step=previewData.Step

   for key,quote in pairs(self.Quotes) do if quote.Last then self.Prices[key]=quote.Last end end

  end

  return self

 end

 self.Remote=root:WaitForChild("OrderRequest",60)

 local update=root:WaitForChild("MarketUpdate",60)

 if not self.Remote or not update then self.Regime="Exchange unavailable" return self end

 self.Connection=update.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet)

  self.DepthAccess=packet.DepthAccess or {Allowed=false,State="Checking"}
  self.DepthReceivedAt=os.clock();self.DepthContract=packet.Contract
  self.DepthLive=not packet.StatusOnly and packet.CanTrade==true
  if not self.DepthAccess.Allowed or not self.DepthLive then
   for _,quote in pairs(self.Quotes)do quote.Depth=nil end
  end

  self.CanTrade=packet.CanTrade==true self.ConnectionStatus=packet.ConnectionStatus self.PersistenceMode=packet.PersistenceMode
 self.RequestSession=packet.RequestSession or self.RequestSession
 self.NextId=math.max(self.NextId,packet.RequestHigh or 0)

  -- Atomic funded portfolio and live unlock projection arrive with each price batch.

  if packet.Portfolio then
   self.Portfolio=packet.Portfolio
   if not self.PreferencesDirty and not self.PreferencesPending then
    self.ProtectionPreferences=Protection.Preferences(packet.Portfolio.ProtectionPreferences)
   end
  end
  -- Lifetime stats are computed and persisted by the server; sent when they change.

  if packet.Stats then self.Stats=packet.Stats self.StatsAt=os.clock() end

  if packet.StatusOnly then
   self.MarketEvent=nil;self.News=nil

   if packet.NoAccount then

    -- No trading account yet (first join): clear any previous account view.

    self.Ready=false self.AccountKey=nil self.AccountToken=nil self.Positions={} self.Orders={} self.History={} self.Fills={}

   end

   for _,reply in ipairs(packet.Replies or {})do self:_reply(reply)end
   for _,event in ipairs(packet.Events or {})do self:_event(event)end

   self:_flushPreferences();self.Changed:Fire()return
  end

  self.Ready=true self.Base=packet.Base self.AccountKey=packet.AccountKey self.AccountToken=packet.AccountToken self.Positions=packet.Positions

  self.Orders=packet.Orders or self.Orders self.History=packet.History or self.History self.Fills=packet.Fills or self.Fills

  self.SummaryData=packet.Summary self.Quotes=packet.Quotes self.Time=packet.Time
  if not self.DepthAccess.Allowed then for _,quote in pairs(self.Quotes)do quote.Depth=nil end end

  -- Server-computed maximum new order per instrument/side (same rule the exchange enforces).

  self.Capacity=packet.Capacity self.Limit=packet.Limit self.Triggers=packet.Triggers or {}

  self.Regime=packet.Regime self.News=packet.News self.MarketEvent=packet.MarketEvent self.Speed=packet.Speed self.Step=packet.Step

  for key,quote in pairs(packet.Quotes) do if quote.Last then self.Prices[key]=quote.Last end end

  local cacheKey=packet.Contract..":"..packet.Timeframe

  -- A subscription can be dropped by the server's request rate limit (fast contract/timeframe

  -- switching). If the server is still streaming another series, ask again instead of waiting forever.

  if(packet.Contract~=self.Contract or packet.Timeframe~=self.Timeframe)and os.clock()-(self.SubscribedAt or 0)>1.5 then

   self:Subscribe(self.Contract,self.Timeframe)

  end

  if packet.Full then self.Cache[cacheKey]=packet.Candles else

   local data=self.Cache[cacheKey] or {} self.Cache[cacheKey]=data

   for _,candle in ipairs(packet.Candles) do

    local found=false

    for i=math.max(1,#data-2),#data do if data[i].Time==candle.Time then data[i]=candle found=true break end end

    if not found then table.insert(data,candle) end

   end

   while #data>Config.MaxCandles do table.remove(data,1) end

  end

  for _,reply in ipairs(packet.Replies or {}) do self:_reply(reply) end
  for _,event in ipairs(packet.Events or {})do self:_event(event)end

  self:_flushPreferences();self.Changed:Fire()
 end)

 self:Subscribe(Config.ContractOrder[1],Timeframes.Default)

 local start=os.clock() while not self.Ready and not self.ConnectionStatus and os.clock()-start<45 do task.wait(0.1) end

 return self

end

-- Server events (unlocks, depletion notices) are announced once. Events that arrive before the UI

-- listens (the first packets after joining or reconnecting) are kept and replayed to OnEvent.

function Session:_event(event)
 if (event.Kind=="RankUp" or event.Kind=="Milestone")and event.Id then
  self.ProgressionEvents=self.ProgressionEvents or {};local key=event.Kind..":"..event.Id
  if self.ProgressionEvents[key]then return end;self.ProgressionEvents[key]=true
 end
 if event.Kind=="TradeClosed"then
  -- Execution identity, not price or a disappearing position, is the source of confirmation.
  if not event.Account or not event.TradeId then return end
  local key=event.Account..":"..event.TradeId
  if self.ClosedEvents[key]then return end
  self.ClosedEvents[key]=true;table.insert(self.ClosedEventOrder,key)
  if #self.ClosedEventOrder>128 then self.ClosedEvents[table.remove(self.ClosedEventOrder,1)]=nil end
 end
 if self.EventHandler then self.EventHandler(event) else table.insert(self.EventBacklog,event) end

 self.Events:Fire(event)

end
function Session:_reply(reply)
 self.Pending[reply.RequestId]=nil
 local pending=self.PreferencesPending
 if pending and pending.Id==reply.RequestId then
  self.PreferencesPending=nil
  if reply.Ok and Protection.SamePreferences(self.ProtectionPreferences,pending.Value)then self.PreferencesDirty=false end
  -- A retry can be rejected during an exchange pause; retain the latest local intention.
  self.PreferencesRetryAt=os.clock()+(reply.Ok and 0 or 2)
 end
 self.Replies:Fire(reply)
end
function Session:_flushPreferences(force)
 if self.Preview or not self.PreferencesDirty or not self.CanTrade then return end
 if not force and os.clock()<(self.PreferencesRetryAt or 0)then return end
 local pending=self.PreferencesPending
 if not force and pending and os.clock()-pending.At<2 then return end
 if pending then self.Pending[pending.Id]=nil end
 local value=table.clone(self.ProtectionPreferences)
 local ok,_,_,id=self:Send("ProtectionPreferences",table.clone(value))
 if ok then self.PreferencesPending={Id=id,Value=value,At=os.clock()}end
end
function Session:SetProtectionPreferences(value)
 local clean=Protection.ValidatePreferences(value)
 if not clean then return false,"Check your stop loss and take profit settings. Use amounts greater than $0."end
 self.ProtectionPreferences=clean;self.PreferencesDirty=true;self:_flushPreferences(true)
 return true
end
function Session:OnEvent(fn)

 self.EventHandler=fn

 local backlog=self.EventBacklog self.EventBacklog={}

 for _,event in ipairs(backlog) do fn(event) end

end

function Session:Send(action,request,expectedAccount)

 if self.Preview then return false,"Edit preview only. Press Play to trade." end

 if not self.Remote then return false,"Connecting to the exchange. Try again in a moment." end

 if action~="Subscribe"and action~="Stats"and not self.CanTrade then return false,self.ConnectionStatus or "Waiting for the exchange."end

 local now=os.clock()
 -- Bound pending acknowledgements even when the server rate-limits or loses a reply.
 local pendingCount,oldestId,oldestAt=0,nil,math.huge
 for id,at in pairs(self.Pending)do
  if now-at>30 then self.Pending[id]=nil else
   pendingCount+=1;if at<oldestAt then oldestId=id;oldestAt=at end
  end
 end
 if action=="Place"then
  self.PlaceTokens=math.min(6,(self.PlaceTokens or 6)+(now-(self.PlaceTokenTime or now))*5);self.PlaceTokenTime=now
  if self.PlaceTokens<1 then return false,"Orders are arriving too quickly. Wait a moment before placing another."end
  self.PlaceTokens-=1
 end

 self.NextId+=1 request=request or {} request.Id=self.NextId request.Action=action
 request.RequestSession=self.RequestSession

 request.ExpectedAccount=expectedAccount or self.AccountToken

 -- These read requests are answered by a snapshot, not a request acknowledgement.
 if action~="Subscribe"and action~="Stats"then
  if pendingCount>=64 and oldestId then self.Pending[oldestId]=nil end
  self.Pending[self.NextId]=now
 end
 self.Remote:FireServer(request)

 return true,"Order sent to exchange.","Orders",self.NextId

end

function Session:Subscribe(key,tf)

 self.Contract=key self.Timeframe=tf self.SubscribedAt=os.clock() self:Send("Subscribe",{Contract=key,Timeframe=tf})

end

function Session:Candles(key,tf) return self.Cache[key..":"..tf] or {} end

function Session:Pnl(p) return p.Unrealized or 0 end

function Session:Summary() return self.SummaryData end

function Session:Working() return self.Orders end

function Session:Cancel(id,protection) return self:Send("Cancel",{OrderId=id,Protection=protection}) end

function Session:AmendProtection(key,id,field,price,expectedPrice,expectedQuantity)

 return self:Send("AmendProtection",{Contract=key,OrderId=id,Protection=field,Price=price,ExpectedPrice=expectedPrice,ExpectedQuantity=expectedQuantity})

end

function Session:AmendOrder(key,id,price,expectedPrice,expectedQuantity)

 return self:Send("AmendOrder",{Contract=key,OrderId=id,Price=price,ExpectedPrice=expectedPrice,ExpectedQuantity=expectedQuantity})

end

function Session:Close(key) return self:Send("Close",{Contract=key}) end

-- Lifecycle requests always include ExpectedAccount through Send.

function Session:Start() return self:Send("Start",{}) end

function Session:Restart() return self:Send("Restart",{}) end
function Session:ResetAccount(expectedAccount) return self:Send("ResetAccount",{},expectedAccount) end
function Session:AcknowledgeAway(id) return self:Send("AcknowledgeAway",{SummaryId=id})end
function Session:CreateProtection(key,id,field,price,quantity)
 return self:Send("AmendProtection",{Contract=key,OrderId=id,Protection=field,Price=price,Create=true,ExpectedQuantity=quantity})
end

function Session:Flag(stage) return self:Send("Flag",{Stage=stage}) end

function Session:RefreshStats() return self:Send("Stats",{}) end

-- orderType: "Market", "Limit" (price = limit) or "Stop" (price = stop trigger; an entry that becomes a

-- market order when a trade reaches it). The server validates every field.

function Session:Place(key,direction,quantity,orderType,price,stopDollars,targetDollars,execution)

 if not self.Ready then return false,"Connecting to the exchange. Try again in a moment." end

 return self:Send("Place",{Contract=key,Direction=direction,Quantity=quantity,Type=orderType,Execution=execution or "Immediate",

  Price=(orderType=="Limit" or orderType=="Stop") and price or nil,StopDollars=stopDollars,TargetDollars=targetDollars})

end

-- Largest order the exchange currently accepts for this instrument and side (nil until the first packet).

function Session:MaxOrder(key,direction)

 local c=self.Capacity and self.Capacity[key]

 return c and (direction>0 and c.Buy or c.Sell) or nil

end

function Session:Destroy()

 if self.Connection then self.Connection:Disconnect() end self.Changed:Destroy() self.Replies:Destroy() self.Events:Destroy()

end

return Market

-- Market Alert Bar. Presentation only: describes an already-executed instrument price move.

local Banner={} Banner.__index=Banner
local INK=Color3.fromRGB(3,18,52)

local function make(class,name,parent,props)

local function frame(parent,name,color,z)

end

  Font=Enum.Font.FredokaOne,TextSize=size,TextColor3=color or WHITE,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
  TextStrokeColor3=INK,TextStrokeTransparency=.35,TextScaled=true})

end
function Banner.new(root)
 local self=setmetatable({Root=root,LastId=nil,StartedAt=nil,Count=0},Banner)
 local group=make("CanvasGroup","MarketEventBanner",root,{BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,
  Active=false,Visible=false,ZIndex=20,GroupTransparency=1})
 self.Group=group
 local body=frame(group,"Bar",WHITE);corner(body,12)
 shade(body,Color3.fromRGB(11,47,105),INK)
 self.Body=body;self.Glow=stroke(body,GREEN,6,.82);self.Rim=stroke(body,GREEN,2)
 local track=frame(body,"LightTrack",WHITE,21);track.BackgroundTransparency=1;track.ClipsDescendants=true;track.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1);corner(track,12)

 for _,name in ipairs({"TopSweep","BottomSweep"})do

 local tab=frame(body,"EventTab",WHITE,22);corner(tab,10)

 self.Tab=tab

 self.Tag.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
 -- A small native gold megaphone stays crisp at every screen size, without an asset download.

function Banner:Clear()

end
function Banner:Update(event,simTime,allowed,now,contract)
 if contract and self.Contract and contract~=self.Contract then self:Clear()end
 if type(event)=='table'and contract and event.Contract~=contract then return false end
 if type(event)~="table"or type(event.Id)~="string"or(event.Direction~=1 and event.Direction~=-1)
  or type(event.ExpiresAt)~="number"or type(simTime)~="number"then return false end
 if self.LastId==event.Id then return false end
 self.LastId=event.Id -- Consume hidden/expired announcements too; never replay them after a dialog.
 if not allowed or event.ExpiresAt<=simTime then return false end
 self.StartedAt=now or os.clock();self.Direction=event.Direction;self.Contract=event.Contract;self.Count+=1
 local up=event.Direction==1;local color=up and GREEN or PINK

function Banner:_layout(plot)
 local space=plot.AbsoluteSize;local origin=plot.AbsolutePosition-self.Root.AbsolutePosition
 local width=math.min(800,math.max(0,space.X-28));local height=(width<500 or space.Y<230)and 52 or 68
 if width<220 or space.Y<85 then return false end
 local compact=width<440;local short=height==52
 self.X=origin.X+(space.X-width)/2-4;self.Y=origin.Y+6

 if self.Width==width and self.Height==height then return true end
 self.Width=width;self.Height=height
 rect(self.Body,4,4,width,height)
 local tabW=compact and 44 or(short and 116 or 142)
 rect(self.Tab,1,1,tabW-2,height-2)
 self.Icon.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(compact and 6 or 9,(height-32)/2-1)
 self.Tag.Visible=not compact;rect(self.Tag,44,6,tabW-50,height-12)
 local right=compact and 32 or 112
 local tx=tabW+12;local tw=width-tx-right-10
 rect(self.Title,tx,short and 5 or 8,tw,short and 24 or 32)
 self.Title.TextLimit.MaxTextSize=compact and 19 or(short and 23 or 28)
 rect(self.Subtitle,tx,short and 29 or 41,tw,short and 17 or 19)
 self.Subtitle.TextLimit.MaxTextSize=compact and 11 or(short and 12 or 15)
 self.Arrows.Visible=not compact;rect(self.Arrows,width-112,8,46,height-16)
 rect(self.Candles,width-(compact and 32 or 63),7,compact and 25 or 52,height-14)
 for i,beam in ipairs(self.Sweeps)do rect(beam,-120,i==1 and 1 or height-3,120,2)end
 return true
end
function Banner:Step(plot,allowed,calm,now)
 if not allowed then self:Clear();return end
 if not self.StartedAt or not plot or not plot.Parent then self.Group.Visible=false;return end
 local age=(now or os.clock())-self.StartedAt
 if age>=DURATION or age<0 then self:Clear();return end
 if not self:_layout(plot)then self.Group.Visible=false;return end
 self.Group.Visible=true
 local enter=math.clamp(age/.32,0,1);local leave=math.clamp((DURATION-age)/.35,0,1)
 local eased=1-(1-enter)^3
 self.Group.GroupTransparency=1-math.min(enter,leave)
 self.Group.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(self.X,self.Y+(calm and 0 or -20*(1-eased)+8*(1-leave)))
 self.Glow.Transparency=calm and .82 or .8+.08*math.sin(age*3)
 for i,beam in ipairs(self.Sweeps)do
  beam.Visible=not calm
  if not calm then beam.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(((age*.65+(i-1)*.5)%1)*(self.Width+120)-120,i==1 and 1 or self.Height-3)end
 end
 self.Arrows.TextTransparency=calm and 0 or .12+.2*(1+math.sin(age*5))
 self.Arrows.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(self.Width-112+(calm and 0 or 3*math.sin(age*5)),8)
 local cw=self.Candles.Size.X.Offset;local ch=self.Candles.Size.Y.Offset
 for i,bar in ipairs(self.Bars)do
  local rank=self.Direction==1 and i or 4-i
  local bh=math.floor(ch*(.32+rank*.09));local y=math.floor((4-rank)*ch*.16)
  local bob=calm and 0 or math.sin(age*4-i*.6)*1.5
  local x=(i-1)*cw/3+2;local bw=math.max(4,math.floor(cw/3)-4)
  rect(bar.Wick,x+bw/2-1,y-3+bob,2,bh+7)
  rect(bar.Body,x,y+bob,bw,bh)
 end
end
function Banner:Destroy()self.Group:Destroy()end
return Banner

 Green=Color3.fromRGB(78,222,112),GreenDark=Color3.fromRGB(26,158,74),Ear=Color3.fromRGB(150,250,170),

-- Design grid: 100 x 120 units. Parts use scale coordinates of that box.

 f.Position=UDim2.fromScale(x/(opts.PW or GW),y/(opts.PH or GH));f.Size=UDim2.fromScale(w/(opts.PW or GW),h/(opts.PH or GH))

function Mascot.new(parent,size,opts)
 opts=opts or {}
 local self=setmetatable({Strokes={},Mood="Happy",Talking=false,Calm=opts.Calm==true,Alive=true,NextBlink=os.clock()+1.2,WaveUntil=0,HopAt=-10},Mascot)
 local z=opts.ZIndex or 1;self.Z=z

 local rig=Instance.new("Frame");rig.Name="Rig";rig.BackgroundTransparency=1;rig.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1);rig.ZIndex=z;rig.Parent=holder;self.Rig=rig

 local torso=part(rig,"Jacket",22,72,56,42,K.JacketDark,z+1,{Radius=.28,Top=K.Jacket});ink(torso,1)
 part(torso,"Tee",39,0,22,42,K.Tee,z+2,{PW=100,PH=42,Radius=.2})

 part(muzzle,"NostrilL",26,16,12,14,K.Nostril,z+7,{PW=100,PH=100,Radius=.5})

 holder.Parent=parent

-- Human-entered decimal numbers; field-specific bounds and rounding stay with the caller.
local NumberInput={}
local multipliers={k=1e3,m=1e6,b=1e9,t=1e12}
function NumberInput.Parse(text)
 if type(text)~="string"then return nil end
 local raw=text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
 if raw:sub(1,1)=="$"then raw=raw:sub(2):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")end
 local amount,suffix=raw:match("^(.-)%s*([kKmMbBtT])$")
 amount=amount or raw
 local sign,whole,decimal=amount:match("^([+-]?)([%d,]*)%.?(%d*)$")
 if not whole or whole==""and decimal==""then return nil end
 if whole:find(",",1,true)then
  local first,rest=whole:match("^(%d%d?%d?)(,.*)$")
  if not first or rest:gsub(",%d%d%d","")~=""then return nil end
 end
 local value=tonumber(sign..whole:gsub(",","").."."..decimal)
 if not value then return nil end
 value*=suffix and multipliers[suffix:lower()]or 1
 if value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then return nil end
 return value
end
return NumberInput

-- Shared definitions and pure presentation. Only FundedAccounts awards progression.
local Config=require(script.Parent.ProgressionConfig)
local Rules={}
function Rules.Rank(id)
 for index,r in ipairs(Config.Ranks) do if r.Id==id then return r,index end end
 return nil
end
function Rules.Metric(m,net,trades,wins)
 return math.max(0,m.Kind=="Trades" and trades or m.Kind=="Wins" and wins or net)
end
function Rules.Qualifies(r,net,trades,wins)
 return trades>=r.Trades and wins>=r.Wins and (r.Profit==0 or net+1e-6>=r.Profit)
end
function Rules.Obsolete(title)
 return title:match("^Legacy .*Trader$")~=nil or title:match("^%d+K Trader$")~=nil or title=="Legacy Top Tier Complete"
end
function Rules.Normalize(p,at)
 if p.ProgressionVersion==Config.ProgressionVersion then return false end
 p.LegacyProgression=p.LegacyProgression or {Titles=table.clone(p.Titles or {}),Rank=p.Rank}
 p.Awards=p.Awards or {};p.AlumniTitles=p.AlumniTitles or {}
 local known={};for _,m in ipairs(Config.Milestones)do known[m.Title]=m; if m.OldTitle then known[m.OldTitle]=m end end
 local seen={};for _,title in ipairs(p.AlumniTitles)do seen[title]=true end
 for _,title in ipairs(p.Titles or {})do
  local m=known[title]
  if m then p.Awards[m.Id]=p.Awards[m.Id] or {At=at,Title=title,Preserved=true}
  else
   local display=Rules.Obsolete(title) and "Founding Trader" or title
   if not seen[display]then table.insert(p.AlumniTitles,display);seen[display]=true end
  end
 end
 p.ProgressionVersion=Config.ProgressionVersion
 return true
end
function Rules.Titles(p)
 local titles,seen={},{};local current
 for _,m in ipairs(Config.Milestones)do if p.Awards[m.Id]then
  if not seen[m.Title]then table.insert(titles,m.Title);seen[m.Title]=true end;current=m
 end end
 for _,title in ipairs(p.AlumniTitles or {})do if not seen[title]then table.insert(titles,title);seen[title]=true end end
 return titles,current
end

-- Smooth, transparent native rings. Circular strokes keep the inner/outer curves concentric;
-- a radial half-plane cuts each coloured prefix at the exact statistical angle.
-- No uploaded textures, pixel wedges, tessellation seams, or opaque centre masks.
local Charts={}
function Charts.Draw(ctx,parent,name,cx,cy,radius,thickness,win,loss,half,colors)
 local container=ctx.frame(parent,name,cx-radius-thickness/2-2,cy-radius-thickness/2-2,
  radius*2+thickness+4,(half and radius or radius*2)+thickness+4,colors.Neutral,4)
 container.BackgroundTransparency=1
 local margin=thickness/2+2 local center=radius+margin
 win=win and math.clamp(win,0,1) or nil
 loss=win and math.clamp(loss or 0,0,1-win) or 0
 container:SetAttribute("Renderer","CircularStroke")
 container:SetAttribute("WinShare",win)
 container:SetAttribute("LossShare",loss)
 container:SetAttribute("NeutralShare",win and math.max(0,1-win-loss) or 1)
 container:SetAttribute("Thickness",thickness)
 container:SetAttribute("ArcDegrees",half and 180 or 360)
 local function layer(label,color,share,z,side)
  if share<=0 then return end
  local clip=ctx.frame(container,label,side=="Right"and center or 0,0,
   half and center*2 or center,half and center or center*2,color,z)
  clip.BackgroundTransparency=1 clip.ClipsDescendants=true
  local disk=ctx.frame(clip,"Circle",side=="Right"and -radius or margin,margin,radius*2,radius*2,color,z)
  disk.BackgroundTransparency=1 ctx.round(disk,radius)
  local stroke=ctx.stroke(disk,color) stroke.Thickness=thickness stroke.BorderStrokePosition=Enum.BorderStrokePosition.Center
  if share<1 then
   local rotation=half and 90-share*180 or (side=="Right"and share*180 or 180+share*180)
   local cut=Instance.new("UIGradient") cut.Name="RadialBoundary" cut.Rotation=rotation
   local first,last=half and 1 or 0,half and 0 or 1
   cut.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,first),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.4995,first),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.5005,last),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,last)})
   cut.Parent=stroke
  end
 end
 local function prefix(label,color,share,z)
  if half then layer(label,color,share,z,"Top")
  else
   layer(label.."Right",color,math.clamp(share*2,0,1),z,"Right")
   layer(label.."Left",color,math.clamp(share*2-1,0,1),z,"Left")
  end
 end
 prefix("Track",colors.Neutral,1,4)
 if win then
  prefix("Loss",colors.Loss,win+loss,5)
  prefix("Win",colors.Win,win,6)
 end

end

local function make(className,name,parent,props)
 local o=Instance.new(className);o.Name=name

local function build(n,parent)
 local o=make(n.kind,n.name,nil,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(n.x,n.y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(n.w,n.h),BorderSizePixel=0,
  BackgroundTransparency=(n.top or n.bg)and(n.transparency or 0)or 1,BackgroundColor3=n.top and Color3.new(1,1,1)or n.bg and color(n.bg)or Color3.new(),
  Rotation=n.rotation or 0,ClipsDescendants=n.clip or false})
 if o:IsA("TextLabel")or o:IsA("TextButton")then
  o.Text=n.text or "";o.TextColor3=color(n.color or Spec.colors.text);o.TextSize=n.size or 20
  o.Font=Enum.Font.FredokaOne
  o.TextXAlignment=n.align=="right"and Enum.TextXAlignment.Right or n.align=="center"and Enum.TextXAlignment.Center or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
  o.TextWrapped=true;o.TextStrokeTransparency=1
 end
 if o:IsA("TextButton")then o.AutoButtonColor=false;o.Active=true;o.Selectable=true end
 if o:IsA("ImageLabel")then o.Image=n.image;o.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit end
 if n.radius then make("UICorner","Corners",o,{CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,n.radius)})end
 if n.edge then make("UIStroke","Border",o,{Color=color(n.edge),Thickness=n.stroke or 1,ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border})end
 if n.top then make("UIGradient","Gradient",o,{Color=ColorSequence.new(color(n.top),color(n.bottom)),Rotation=90})end

end
function Kit.Create(name,parent)
 assert(Spec.templates[name],"Unknown component: "..tostring(name))
 return build(Spec.templates[name],parent)
end
local function money(v)
 if v==nil then return "—" end
 local sign=v<0 and "-" or ""
 local raw=string.format("%.2f",math.abs(v))
 local whole,fraction=raw:match("^(%d+)%.(%d+)$")
 whole=whole:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)","%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,","")
 return sign.."$"..whole.."."..fraction
end
local function percent(v) return v~=nil and string.format("%.2f%%",v*100) or "—" end
local function ratio(v,noLoss) return noLoss and "∞" or v~=nil and string.format("%.2f",v) or "—" end

-- Consumes the same aggregate fields as src/StatsView.luau.
-- Ratios are supplied by the exchange; this adapter only formats them.
function Kit.FromAggregate(a)
 a=a or {}
 local complete=not a.Partial and not a.CountUnknown
 local noLoss=complete and a.NoLosses
 local net=a.Net or 0
 local daily=a.DailyComplete==true
 local best= daily and net>0 and a.BestDayShare or nil
 local unknown="Earlier breakdown unavailable"
 return {
  {Key="Total",Title="Realized profit",Value=money(net),Caption="Current account · closed trades",Color=net<0 and T.Loss or net>0 and T.Gain or T.Text,
   Help="Net profit or loss from closed trades in this account. Excludes open profit and starting money."},
  {Key="Trade",Title="Trade win rate",Value=complete and percent(a.WinRate) or "—",
   Caption=complete and string.format("%d wins / %d trades · %d even",a.Wins or 0,a.Trades or 0,a.Even or 0) or unknown,
   Bars=complete and {a.Wins or 0,a.Losses or 0,a.Even or 0} or nil,
   Help="Profitable closed trades divided by all closed trades, including break-even trades. Each closing fill counts as one trade."},
  {Key="Average",Title="Avg win / avg loss",Value=complete and ratio(a.WinLossRatio,noLoss) or "—",
   Caption=not complete and unknown or noLoss and "No losing trades" or "Average win ÷ absolute average loss",
   Bars=complete and {a.AvgWin or 0,a.AvgLoss or 0,0} or nil,
   Details=complete and {{"Avg win",money(a.AvgWin)},{"Avg loss",a.AvgLoss and money(-a.AvgLoss) or "—"}} or nil,
   Help="Average profit per winning trade divided by average loss per losing trade. ∞ means wins with no losses."},
  {Key="Day",Title="Day win rate",Value=daily and percent(a.DayWinRate) or "—",
   Caption=daily and string.format("%d profitable / %d UTC days",a.WinningDays or 0,a.DayCount or 0) or "Needs complete trade dates",
   Bars=daily and {a.WinningDays or 0,math.max(0,(a.DayCount or 0)-(a.WinningDays or 0)),0} or nil,
   Help="Profitable days divided by days with closed trades in this account. Days run from midnight to midnight UTC. Days without trades do not count."},
  {Key="Factor",Title="Profit factor",Value=complete and ratio(a.ProfitFactor,noLoss) or "—",
   Caption=not complete and unknown or noLoss and "No gross losses" or "Gross wins ÷ absolute gross losses",
   Bars=complete and {a.Gains or 0,a.Loss or 0,0} or nil,
   Details=complete and {{"Gross wins",money(a.Gains or 0)},{"Gross losses",money(-(a.Loss or 0))}} or nil,
   Help="Total profits divided by total losses from closed trades. The bar compares those two totals."},
  {Key="Best",Title="Best day share",Value=percent(best),
   Caption=not daily and "Needs complete trade dates" or net<=0 and "Needs realized profit above $0" or "Best daily net profit ÷ realized profit",
   Help="Your best day's net profit divided by this account's realized profit. Losses on other days can push this above 100%. Needs complete trade dates and realized profit above $0."},
 }
end

local function setText(root,name,value)
 local o=root:FindFirstChild(name,true)
 if o then o.Text=tostring(value)end
 return o
end
local function setBar(root,name,values,complete)
 local bar=root:FindFirstChild(name,true);if not bar then return end
 for _,v in ipairs(bar:GetChildren())do if v:IsA("Frame")then v:Destroy()end end
 local total=0;for _,v in ipairs(values)do total+=math.max(0,v)end
 if not complete or total==0 then return end
 local x=0;local names={"Win","Loss","Even"};local tops={"#29F9BA","#FF85B9","#85A8DB"};local bottoms={"#0AD59E","#F65096","#5977A6"}
 for i,v in ipairs(values)do
  if v>0 then
   local node={kind="Frame",name=name..names[i],x=x*bar.Size.X.Offset,y=0,w=v/total*bar.Size.X.Offset,h=21,top=tops[i],bottom=bottoms[i],radius=10}
   local part=build(node,bar)
   part.Position=UDim2.fromScale(x,0);part.Size=UDim2.fromScale(v/total,1)
   x+=v/total
  end
 end
end
function Kit.ApplyAggregate(root,a)
 local metrics=Kit.FromAggregate(a)
 local names={"Total","Trade","Average","Day","Factor","Best"}
 for i,m in ipairs(metrics)do
  local label=setText(root,names[i].."Value",m.Value)
  if label and i==1 then label.TextColor3=m.Color end
 end
 setText(root,"TradeCaption",string.format("%d wins / %d trades",a.Wins or 0,a.Trades or 0))
 local complete=not a.Partial and not a.CountUnknown
 if not complete then setText(root,"TradeCaption","Earlier breakdown unavailable")end
 for _,pair in ipairs({{"Average",3},{"Factor",5}})do
  local details=metrics[pair[2]].Details
  setText(root,pair[1].."Detail0",details and details[1][2]or"—")
  setText(root,pair[1].."Detail1",details and details[2][2]or"—")
 end
 setText(root,"AttemptsLabel",tostring(a.Attempts or 0).." attempts")
 setText(root,"ClosedTradesLabel",tostring(a.Trades or 0).." closed trades")
 setText(root,"CoverageCopy",not complete and "Trade breakdown incomplete.\nRatios are unavailable."
  or not a.DailyComplete and "Some trades have no dates.\nDaily stats are unavailable."
  or(a.Net or 0)<=0 and "UTC days. Best-day share needs\nrealized profit above $0."
  or "Current account only.\nTrading days use UTC.")
 setBar(root,"TradeBar",{a.Wins or 0,a.Losses or 0,a.Even or 0},complete)
 setBar(root,"AverageBar",{a.AvgWin or 0,a.AvgLoss or 0},complete)
 setBar(root,"FactorBar",{a.Gains or 0,a.Loss or 0},complete)
 return metrics
end
-- Root is the Stats viewport. Popups account for inherited scaling and stay inside it.
function Kit.BindDropdown(root,trigger,items,selectedKey,onChoose)
 local connections={}
 local opened,overlay,selected=false,nil,selectedKey
 local previousSelection
 local api={}
 local function caption()
  for _,item in ipairs(items)do if item.Key==selected then setText(trigger,trigger.Name.."Label",item.Label);return end end
 end
 function api:Close()
  opened=false
  if overlay then overlay:Destroy();overlay=nil end
  if previousSelection and previousSelection.Parent then GuiService.SelectedObject=previousSelection end
  previousSelection=nil
 end
 function api:Set(key)selected=key;caption()end
 function api:Choose(key)
  local exists=false;for _,item in ipairs(items)do if item.Key==key then exists=true end end
  if not exists then return false end
  local accepted=not onChoose or onChoose(key)~=false
  if accepted then self:Set(key)end
  self:Close();return accepted
 end
 function api:Open()
  if self:IsOpen() then self:Close();return end
  -- One menu at a time in the assembled canvas.
  local old=root:FindFirstChild("DropdownOverlay");if old then old:Destroy()end
  opened=true;previousSelection=root:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("PlayerGui")and GuiService.SelectedObject or nil
  overlay=make("TextButton","DropdownOverlay",root,{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,ZIndex=100,Selectable=false})
  overlay.Activated:Connect(function()self:Close()end)
  local scale=root.Size.X.Offset>0 and root.AbsoluteSize.X/root.Size.X.Offset or 1
  scale=math.max(.01,scale)
  local x=(trigger.AbsolutePosition.X-root.AbsolutePosition.X)/scale
  local y=(trigger.AbsolutePosition.Y-root.AbsolutePosition.Y+trigger.AbsoluteSize.Y)/scale+8
  local w=trigger.AbsoluteSize.X/scale
  if w<1 then w=trigger.Size.X.Offset end
  w=math.min(w,math.max(1,root.Size.X.Offset-16))
  local h=math.min(#items*50+12,312,math.max(56,root.Size.Y.Offset-16))
  x=math.clamp(x,8,math.max(8,root.Size.X.Offset-w-8))
  if y+h>root.Size.Y.Offset-8 then y=math.max(8,y-h-trigger.Size.Y.Offset-16)end
  y=math.clamp(y,8,math.max(8,root.Size.Y.Offset-h-8))
  local menu=build({kind="Frame",name="DropdownMenu",x=x,y=y,w=w,h=h,top="#0A3274",bottom="#031B4E",edge="#487DDB",stroke=2,radius=12},overlay);menu.ZIndex=101
  local list=make("ScrollingFrame","Options",menu,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,6),Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,1,-12),CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,#items*50),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ScrollBarThickness=3,ZIndex=102})
  for i,item in ipairs(items)do
   local row=build({kind="TextButton",name="Option"..i,x=0,y=(i-1)*50,w=w-12,h=46,
    top=item.Key==selected and "#863AFF"or"#0A3274",bottom=item.Key==selected and"#491BCD"or"#062250",radius=8,
    text="   "..item.Label,size=18},list);row.ZIndex=103
   row:SetAttribute("Key",item.Key)
   -- A gradient on a TextButton also tints its own text. Keep the label on an un-tinted child.
   row.Text=""
   local label=build({kind="TextLabel",name="Label",x=12,y=0,w=w-36,h=46,text=item.Label,size=w<300 and 14 or 18},row)
   label.ZIndex=104;label.TextScaled=true
   make("UITextSizeConstraint","TypeSize",label,{MinTextSize=10,MaxTextSize=label.TextSize})
   row.Activated:Connect(function()self:Choose(item.Key)end)
   if item.Key==selected and UserInputService.GamepadEnabled and row:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("PlayerGui")then GuiService.SelectedObject=row end
  end
 end
 function api:IsOpen()return opened and overlay~=nil and overlay.Parent~=nil end
 function api:Get()return selected end
 function api:Destroy()self:Close();for _,c in ipairs(connections)do c:Disconnect()end end
 table.insert(connections,trigger.Activated:Connect(function()api:Open()end))
 table.insert(connections,UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
  if api:IsOpen() and (input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Escape or input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB)then api:Close()end
 end))
 caption();return api
end
return Kit
StatsView.luau:
-- Stats page: trading performance for the current account. Every number is computed and
-- persisted by the server (TradeStats / FundedAccounts:Stats). Only Stats content is drawn here, using
-- individual editable components from 06 - Polished Stats Pieces. TerminalUI owns all shared navigation.
local TextService=game:GetService("TextService")
local Kit=require(script.Parent.StatsPieces)
local View={}
local LEFT,CENTER,RIGHT=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
local TOP=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
local AtEnd=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
local FONT=Enum.Font.FredokaOne
local BODY=Enum.Font.GothamMedium

local function commas(n)
 local raw=tostring(math.floor(math.abs(n or 0)+0.5))
 return ((n or 0)<0 and "-" or "")..raw:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)","%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,","")
end
local function plural(n,word) return commas(n).." "..word..(n==1 and "" or "s") end
local function pct(rate) return rate and string.format("%.1f%%",rate*100) or "—" end
local function measure(value,size,width,font) return math.ceil(TextService:GetTextSize(value,size,font or FONT,Vector2.new(math.max(1,width-4),10000)).Y*1.12)+8 end
View.Commas=commas

-- Always use the current account, including when an older UI state selected another period.
-- Do not display a previous account's cached packet while a restart is loading.
function View.Resolve(data,state,portfolio)
 local list=data and data.Scopes or {};local scope=list[1]
 state.StatsScope="ALL";state.StatsPeriod="Current"
 local agg=scope and scope.Current
 if data and portfolio and data.Run and portfolio.Run and data.Run~=portfolio.Run then agg=nil end
 return scope,agg,"Current",list
end
function View.OpenFor(scope,pf,agg)return pf and pf.Open or agg and agg.Open or 0 end
function View.Describe(scope,agg,period)
 return "Current account only. Starting money and open profit are excluded."
end
function View.Coverage(agg,signed)
 if agg.Partial then
  local count=agg.UntrackedTrades>0 and (" across "..(agg.CountUnknown and "at least " or "")..plural(agg.UntrackedTrades,"earlier trade"))
   or (agg.CountUnknown and " across an unknown number of earlier trades" or "")
  return "Results without a full breakdown (net "..signed(agg.UntrackedNet)..count..") are included in realized profit. Ratios need a complete trade breakdown."
 elseif agg.Recovered then
  return "Includes earlier trades rebuilt from your saved trade history."
 end
 return nil
end

function View.Draw(ctx,x,y,w,h,mobile)
 local C=ctx.C local s=ctx.State local data=ctx.Data
 local white=Color3.fromHex("F5F8FF") local muted=Color3.fromHex("CEDDFA")
 local sc=ctx.make("ScrollingFrame","Stats",ctx.Canvas,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h),CanvasSize=UDim2.new(),
  BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ScrollBarThickness=4,ScrollBarImageColor3=muted,ScrollingDirection=Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y})
 local cw,inset=ctx.insetScroll(sc) local narrow=cw<620 local gap=narrow and 12 or 18
 local function label(parent,name,value,xx,yy,ww,hh,size,color,body)
  return ctx.make("TextLabel",name,parent,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(xx,yy),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(ww,hh),BackgroundTransparency=1,
   Text=value,TextColor3=color or white,TextSize=size,Font=body and BODY or FONT,TextXAlignment=LEFT,TextWrapped=true,TextScaled=false,LineHeight=1.12})
 end
 local function box(o,xx,yy,ww,hh)
  o.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(xx,yy) o.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(ww,hh) return o
 end
 local function fit(o,size)
  o.TextScaled=false;o.TextSize=size;o.LineHeight=1.12;o.TextStrokeTransparency=1
  return o
 end
 local function copy(o,xx,yy,ww,size)
  o.Font=BODY;o.TextColor3=muted;fit(o,size)
  return box(o,xx,yy,ww,measure(o.Text,size,ww,BODY)).Size.Y.Offset
 end
 -- Exact numbers keep a stable size. Exceptional values can be panned instead of shrinking.
 local function number(o,xx,yy,ww,size)
  fit(o,size);o.Font=FONT;o.TextWrapped=false;o.TextStrokeColor3=Color3.fromHex("061B48");o.TextStrokeTransparency=.86
  local hh=math.ceil(size*1.3)+8
  local needed=math.ceil(TextService:GetTextSize(o.Text,size,FONT,Vector2.new(100000,1000)).X)+8
  if needed>ww then
   local scroller=ctx.make("ScrollingFrame",o.Name.."Overflow",o.Parent,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(xx,yy),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(ww,hh+6),
    CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(needed,0),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ScrollBarThickness=3,ScrollBarImageColor3=muted,ScrollingDirection=Enum.ScrollingDirection.X})
   o.Parent=scroller;box(o,0,0,needed,hh);o.TextXAlignment=LEFT

-- Fixed-size text for labels on cards that lift on hover. TextScaled re-measures against the lifted (UIScale)
-- size and can re-wrap, so these take the largest size up to the label's constraint that fits its box once.
local function fixText(label)
 local constraint=label:FindFirstChild("TypeSize")
 local size=constraint and constraint.MaxTextSize or label.TextSize
 local floor=constraint and constraint.MinTextSize or 8
 local w,h=label.Size.X.Offset,label.Size.Y.Offset
 local function fits(n)
  for line in (label.Text.."\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n")do if TextService:GetTextSize(line,n,label.Font,Vector2.new(1e4,1e4)).X>w then return false end end
  return TextService:GetTextSize(label.Text,n,label.Font,Vector2.new(1e4,1e4)).Y<=h
 end
 while size>floor and not fits(size)do size-=1 end
 label.TextScaled=false;label.TextWrapped=false;label.TextSize=size
 return label
end

 local function submitOrder(dir,orderType,price,qty,label)
  if s.PendingOrder then toast("Waiting for the previous order's confirmation…","info");return false end
  local paths=dir>0 and tradePaths or sellPaths
  if type(qty)~="number" or qty~=qty or qty==math.huge or qty<1 or qty%1~=0 then fail("Enter a whole number of contracts, starting at 1.");effect(paths,"Error");return false end
  for _,field in ipairs({"Stop","Target"})do
   if s[field.."On"]then
    local resolved,err=Market.Protection(Market.Contracts[s.Contract],qty,s[field.."Dollars"])
    if not resolved then fail(err);effect(paths,"Error");return false end
   end
  end
  local max=session:MaxOrder(s.Contract,dir)
  if max and qty>max then
   fail("Order too large. Available now: "..max.." "..s.Contract.." contracts.");effect(paths,"Error");return false
  end
  local ok,msg,tab,requestId=session:Place(s.Contract,dir,qty,orderType,price,s.StopOn and s.StopDollars or nil,s.TargetOn and s.TargetDollars or nil,"Immediate")
  if ok then
   s.Error=nil;s.Tab=orderType=="Market"and tab or"Orders";s.Sheet=false
   local pending={Id=requestId,Direction=dir,At=os.clock()};s.PendingOrder=pending

   -- Full fills and accepted working orders stay quiet; incomplete fills must explain
   -- why the position differs from the requested quantity, including cancelled remainders.
   if reply.Ok and(reply.Kind=="Place"or order)then
    local result=reply.Result
    if result and (result.Queued or (result.Cancelled or 0)>0 or (result.Filled or 0)>0 and (result.Remaining or 0)>0) then
     toast(reply.Message,"info")
    else s.Toast=nil;refresh()end
   elseif reply.Ok and reply.Kind=="Close"and reply.Result and(reply.Result.Filled or 0)>0 then
    refresh() -- The matching TradeClosed event supplies the one close notification.
   elseif reply.Kind~="Flag"or not reply.Ok then
    toast(reply.Message,not reply.Ok and"error"or(closing or restarting)and"success"or"info")
   else refresh()end
  end))
  -- Events include any that arrived before the workspace mounted (e.g. a depletion while away).
  local announcedRank=session.Portfolio and session.Portfolio.RankId
  local depletedAccounts={}
  session:OnEvent(function(event)
   if not alive then return end
   if event.Kind=="Depleted"then
    depletedAccounts[event.Tier]=true
    -- Remove an already-visible close card and invalidate its delayed follow-up.
    if s.ToastPnl~=nil then toastId+=1;s.Toast=nil;s.ToastPnl=nil;s.ToastFollowup=nil end
    table.insert(blownQueue,{Tier=event.Tier,Event=event.Event})
    if fx then fx:Play("Error")end
    if s.Overlay~="Blown"then s.Overlay=nil;s.ProtectionDraft=nil;nextBlown()end
    refresh();return
   end
   if event.Kind=="TradeClosed" then
    local account=tierRow(event.Account)
    if event.Reason=="Account depleted"or depletedAccounts[event.Account]or account and account.Depleted then return end
    local pnl=event.Pnl or 0
    local notices={}
    local rewards=event.Rewards or {}
    if #rewards==1 then table.insert(notices,"Title earned: "..rewards[1])
    elseif #rewards>1 then table.insert(notices,#rewards.." titles earned")end
    -- Closing fills carry title rewards; the updated portfolio carries the earned rank.
    -- Announce awards after the compact close card, keeping its copy to title and P&L.
    local pf=session.Portfolio
    if pf and announcedRank and pf.RankId~=announcedRank then table.insert(notices,"Rank up: "..pf.Rank)end
    announcedRank=pf and pf.RankId or announcedRank
    toast("Trade closed · "..Market.Signed(pnl),pnl>0 and"success"or"info",pnl,#notices>0 and table.concat(notices," · ")or nil)
    if event.Reason=="Take profit"then
     if fx then fx:PlayFill("TakeProfit")end
    elseif event.Reason=="Stop loss"then
     if fx then fx:PlayFill("StopLoss")end
    else
     if fx then fx:Play("Success")end
    end
   elseif event.Kind=="RankUp" then announcedRank=event.Id;if fx then fx:Play("Milestone")end;toast("Rank up: "..event.Name,"success")
   elseif event.Kind=="Milestone" then if fx then fx:Play("Milestone") end;celebrate(event) end
   refresh()
  end)
 end
 table.insert(connections,leaderboard.Changed.Event:Connect(refresh))
 render()
 marketBanner:Update(session.MarketEvent,session.Time,session.DepthLive and not s.Overlay and not s.Sheet,nil,session.Contract)
 if not options.Preview then
  guide=WelcomeGuide.new({Gui=gui,Root=root,Canvas=canvas,State=s,Session=session,Market=Market,Fx=feedback,Whole=whole,
   GoTrade=function()navigate("Trade")end,GoProgress=function()navigate("Progress")end})
 end
 -- Studio-only layout/test hook: read or set presentation state and rebuild synchronously.
 if RunService:IsStudio()and not options.Preview then
  local hook=Instance.new("BindableFunction");hook.Name="UIDiagnostics";hook.Parent=root
  hook.OnInvoke=function(command,key,value)
   if command=="Set"then s[key]=value;render();return true
   elseif command=="Get"then return s[key]
   elseif command=="Render"then render();return true end
   return nil
  end
 end
 local controller={Root=root,State=s,Chart=chartView,MarketBanner=marketBanner}
 function controller:Destroy()alive=false;marketBanner:Destroy();if guide then guide:Destroy()end;depthPurchase:Destroy();for _,view in ipairs(depthViews)do view:Destroy()end;leaderboard:Destroy();chartView:Destroy();session:Destroy();if feedback then feedback:Destroy()end;if fx==feedback then fx=nil end;for _,c in ipairs(connections)do c:Disconnect()end;if root.Parent then root:Destroy()end end
 return controller
end

TradeProtection.luau:
-- One dollar-to-tick calculation shared by the ticket and authoritative exchange.
-- Dollars are the estimated TOTAL for the requested quantity, excluding slippage.
local Protection={}
Protection.MaxDollars=1e9
Protection.Defaults={StopOn=true,TargetOn=true,StopDollars=500,TargetDollars=1500}
-- Preferences are dollar intentions, independent of the current instrument/quantity.
-- The ticket, saved preferences and exchange share the same dollar ceiling.
function Protection.Preferences(value)
 local result={}
 for key,default in pairs(Protection.Defaults)do
  local v;if type(value)=="table"then v=value[key]end
  if type(default)=="boolean"then
   if type(v)=="boolean"then result[key]=v else result[key]=default end
  else result[key]=type(v)=="number"and v==v and v>=.01 and v<=Protection.MaxDollars and v or default end
 end
 return result
end
function Protection.ValidatePreferences(value)
 if type(value)~="table"then return nil end
 for key,default in pairs(Protection.Defaults)do
  local v=value[key]
  if type(v)~=type(default)then return nil end
  if type(v)=="number"and(v~=v or v<.01 or v>Protection.MaxDollars)then return nil end
 end
 return Protection.Preferences(value)
end
function Protection.SamePreferences(a,b)
 for key in pairs(Protection.Defaults)do if a[key]~=b[key]then return false end end
 return true
end
function Protection.MaximumTicks(spec,quantity)
 -- Include the nearest tick at the dollar ceiling, including the one-tick minimum.
 return math.max(1,math.round(Protection.MaxDollars/(spec.Tick*spec.Multiplier*quantity)))
end
function Protection.Resolve(spec,quantity,dollars,entry,direction,field)
 if type(quantity)~="number" or quantity<1 or quantity%1~=0 then return nil,"Enter a whole number of contracts, starting at 1." end
 local unit=spec.Tick*spec.Multiplier*quantity
 if type(dollars)~="number" or dollars~=dollars or dollars<.01 or dollars>Protection.MaxDollars then
  return nil,"Enter a protection amount from $0.01 to $1,000,000,000."
 end
 local ticks=math.max(1,math.round(dollars/unit))
 local result={Ticks=ticks,Dollars=ticks*unit,TickDollars=unit}
 if entry then
  local side=(field=="Stop" and -1 or 1)*(direction or 1)
  result.Price=math.round((entry+side*ticks*spec.Tick)/spec.Tick)*spec.Tick
  result.Dollars=math.abs(result.Price-entry)*spec.Multiplier*quantity
 end
 return result
end
return Protection
UIFeedback.luau:
-- Interaction feedback for the Get Funded! GUI: hover/press/release tweens, selection pops, popup
-- transitions and a small palette of UI sounds. Presentation only; it never changes trading state.
-- The GUI is rebuilt on refresh, so per-control state (hover, last press, selection) is remembered by
-- the control's path. A rebuilt control continues its animation instead of snapping or replaying it.
-- Calm mode (reduced motion) keeps colour and sheen feedback but drops scaling, bouncing and shaking.
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
local SoundService=game:GetService("SoundService")
local UIS=game:GetService("UserInputService")
local GuiService=game:GetService("GuiService")
local FX={} FX.__index=FX

-- Official Roblox GUI sounds (public, Roblox-owned). Volumes are relative to the master volume.
FX.Sounds={
 Click={Id=17208396156,Volume=.30,Gap=.045,Speed=1.05},  -- Roblox GUI - Select
 Tick={Id=17208396156,Volume=.16,Gap=.04,Speed=1.25},    -- steppers: lighter and shorter
 Select={Id=17208204604,Volume=.24,Gap=.06},             -- Roblox GUI - Bubble: tabs, segments, toggles
 Open={Id=17208405682,Volume=.18,Gap=.09},               -- Roblox GUI - Swipe: popups and sheets
 Send={Id=17208399163,Volume=.26,Gap=.1},                -- Roblox GUI - Send: order submitted (not confirmed)
 Success={Id=17208380755,Volume=.34,Gap=.12},            -- Roblox GUI - Purchase: server-confirmed action
 TakeProfit={Id=17208380755,Volume=.34,Gap=0},          -- Confirmed TP: success
 StopLoss={Id=17208353912,Volume=.30,Gap=0},            -- Confirmed SL: distinct negative tone
 Milestone={Id=17208361335,Volume=.36,Gap=.4},           -- Roblox GUI - Notification High: unlocks
 Error={Id=17208353912,Volume=.30,Gap=.22},              -- Roblox GUI - Negative: rejected or invalid
}
FX.Levels={Low=.35,Medium=.65,High=1}
local QUICK=TweenInfo.new(.07,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local HOVER=TweenInfo.new(.12,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local SETTLE=TweenInfo.new(.14,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local BOUNCE=TweenInfo.new(.26,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local POP=TweenInfo.new(.22,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

function FX.new(root,options)
 options=options or {}
 local self=setmetatable({Root=root,Memory={},MemoryCount=0,Loops={},Last={},LastAny=0,Tweens=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"}),
  Enabled=options.Sound~=false,Level=options.Level or "Medium",Preview=options.Preview==true,Alive=true,Played={}},FX)
 -- Edit previews are saved into the place; they never create sounds or effect layers.
 if not self.Preview then self:_sounds() end
 return self
end
function FX:_sounds()
 local folder=Instance.new("Folder") folder.Name="GetFundedUISounds"
 local group=Instance.new("SoundGroup") group.Name="GetFundedUI" group.Volume=FX.Levels[self.Level] or .65 group.Parent=SoundService
 self.Group=group self.Folder=folder self.Instances={}
 for name,spec in pairs(FX.Sounds)do
  local s=Instance.new("Sound") s.Name=name s.SoundId="rbxassetid://"..spec.Id s.Volume=spec.Volume s.PlaybackSpeed=spec.Speed or 1
  s.SoundGroup=group s.Parent=folder self.Instances[name]=s
 end
 folder.Parent=SoundService
end
function FX:SetCalm(calm)
 self.Calm=calm==true
 if self.Root then self.Root:SetAttribute("ReducedMotion",self.Calm)end
end
function FX:SetSound(enabled,level)
 if enabled~=nil then self.Enabled=enabled==true end
 if level and FX.Levels[level]then self.Level=level end
 if self.Group then self.Group.Volume=FX.Levels[self.Level] end
 if self.Root then self.Root:SetAttribute("SoundEnabled",self.Enabled);self.Root:SetAttribute("SoundLevel",self.Level)end
end
-- Plays one UI sound, rate limited per sound and overall so rapid input never becomes noise.
function FX:Play(name)
 local spec=FX.Sounds[name] local s=self.Instances and self.Instances[name]
 self.Played[name]=(self.Played[name] or 0)+1
 if not spec or not s or not self.Enabled then return false end
 local now=os.clock()
 if now-(self.Last[name] or 0)<spec.Gap or now-self.LastAny<.03 then return false end
 self.Last[name]=now self.LastAny=now
 s.TimePosition=0 s:Play()
 -- Studio diagnostics: how often each sound actually played (after rate limiting).
 if self.Root then self.Root:SetAttribute("SoundPlayed"..name,(self.Root:GetAttribute("SoundPlayed"..name)or 0)+1)end
 return true
end

-- Confirmed executions have already been deduplicated by MarketClient. They must not be
-- dropped by click throttling or cut off by another fill in the same network batch.
function FX:PlayFill(name)
 local template=self.Instances and self.Instances[name]
 if not self.Alive or not self.Enabled or not template then return false end
 local sound=template:Clone();sound.Name=name.."Fill";sound.Parent=self.Folder
 self.Played[name]=(self.Played[name]or 0)+1;self.LastAny=os.clock()
 sound.Ended:Once(function()sound:Destroy()end)
 game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(sound,10)
 sound:Play()
 if self.Root then self.Root:SetAttribute("SoundPlayed"..name,(self.Root:GetAttribute("SoundPlayed"..name)or 0)+1)end
 return true
end

-- An accent only plays when nothing else just played (a popup opened by a click keeps the click).
function FX:Accent(name)
 if os.clock()-self.LastAny<.12 then return false end
 return self:Play(name)
end
-- Per-path memory survives GUI rebuilds.
function FX:Mem(key)
 local m=self.Memory[key]
 if not m then
  if self.MemoryCount>1500 then table.clear(self.Memory) self.MemoryCount=0 end
  m={} self.Memory[key]=m self.MemoryCount+=1
 end
 return m
end
function FX:Tween(o,info,props)
 local old=self.Tweens[o] if old then old:Cancel() end
 local t=TweenService:Create(o,info,props) self.Tweens[o]=t t:Play() return t
end
local function scaleOf(o,name)
 local s=o:FindFirstChild(name or "PressScale")
 if not s then s=Instance.new("UIScale") s.Name=name or "PressScale" s.Parent=o end
 return s
end
FX.ScaleOf=scaleOf
-- UIScale scales around the anchor point; centre it so controls grow and shrink in place.
local function centre(o)
 if o.AnchorPoint~=Vector2.zero or not o.Parent then return end
 local size,pos=o.Size,o.Position
 o.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
 o.Position=pos+UDim2.new(size.X.Scale/2,size.X.Offset/2,size.Y.Scale/2,size.Y.Offset/2)
end
FX.Centre=centre
local function inside(o)
 if not UIS.MouseEnabled or not o.Parent then return false end
 local m=UIS:GetMouseLocation()
 local gui=o:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScreenGui")
 if not(gui and gui.IgnoreGuiInset)then m-=GuiService:GetGuiInset()end
 local p,s=o.AbsolutePosition,o.AbsoluteSize
 return m.X>=p.X and m.X<=p.X+s.X and m.Y>=p.Y and m.Y<=p.Y+s.Y
end
local function sheen(o)
 local f=o:FindFirstChild("HoverSheen")
 if not f then
  f=Instance.new("Frame") f.Name="HoverSheen" f.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1) f.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
  f.BackgroundTransparency=1 f.BorderSizePixel=0 f.ZIndex=o.ZIndex f.Active=false
  local corner=o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
  if corner then local c=Instance.new("UICorner") c.CornerRadius=corner.CornerRadius c.Parent=f end
  f.Parent=o
 end
 return f
end

-- Hover, press and release feedback for one button. Options: Lift, Press, Sheen (0..1), Quiet.
function FX:Bind(b,opts)
 if self.Preview then return end
 opts=opts or {}
 local fixed=b:GetAttribute("FixedGeometry")==true
 local lift,press=fixed and 1 or opts.Lift or 1.035,fixed and 1 or opts.Press or .94
 local glow=opts.Sheen or .9
 local key
 local rest
 local function k() key=key or b:GetFullName() return key end
 local function enabled() return b.Active~=false and not b:GetAttribute("Disabled") end
 local function darken(on)
  if b.BackgroundTransparency>=1 then return end
  rest=rest or b:GetAttribute("RestingColor") or b.BackgroundColor3
  self:Tween(b,on and QUICK or SETTLE,{BackgroundColor3=on and rest:Lerp(Color3.new(0,0,0),.16) or rest})
 end
 local function state(name,instant)
  if not b.Parent then return end
  local sc=scaleOf(b)
  local target=self.Calm and 1 or name=="Down" and press or name=="Hover" and lift or 1
  if instant or self.Calm then sc.Scale=target else
   self:Tween(sc,name=="Down" and QUICK or name=="Release" and BOUNCE or name=="Hover" and HOVER or SETTLE,{Scale=name=="Release" and lift or target})
  end
  if b.BackgroundTransparency<1 or opts.Sheen then
   local f=sheen(b)
   local t=(name=="Hover" or name=="Release") and glow or name=="Down" and math.min(1,glow+.05) or 1
   if instant then f.BackgroundTransparency=t else self:Tween(f,HOVER,{BackgroundTransparency=t})end
  end
 end
 b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
  self:Mem(k()).Hover=true
  if enabled() then state("Hover") end
 end)
 b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
  self:Mem(k()).Hover=false
  state("Leave") darken(false)
 end)
 b.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
  if not enabled() then if not opts.Quiet then self:Shake(b) end return end
  self:Mem(k()).PressedAt=os.clock()
  state("Down") darken(true)
 end)
 b.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
  darken(false)
  if enabled() then state(UIS.MouseEnabled and inside(b) and "Release" or "Leave") end
 end)
 -- After the whole render: centre, then restore hover or finish a press that caused the rebuild.
 task.defer(function()
  if not b.Parent or not self.Alive then return end
  if not fixed then centre(b)end
  local m=self.Memory[k()]
  if not m then return end
  local recent=m.PressedAt and os.clock()-m.PressedAt<.32
  local hovering=m.Hover and inside(b)
  if not hovering then m.Hover=false end
  if recent and enabled() then
   scaleOf(b).Scale=press state(hovering and "Release" or "Leave")
  elseif hovering and enabled() then state("Hover",true) end
 end)
end
-- Debounce: returns true when this activation should be ignored (repeat within `gap`, or disabled).
function FX:Guard(b,gap)
 if b:GetAttribute("Disabled") then return true end
 local m=self:Mem(b:GetFullName()) local now=os.clock()
 if m.ActivatedAt and now-m.ActivatedAt<(gap or .12) then return true end
 m.ActivatedAt=now m.PressedAt=m.PressedAt or now
 return false
end
-- Pops a control when it becomes selected (not when it is merely rebuilt while selected).
function FX:Selected(o,selected)
 if self.Preview or not o.Parent then return end
 if self.Calm then self:Mem(o:GetFullName()).Selected=selected;return end
 local m=self:Mem(o:GetFullName())
 local was=m.Selected m.Selected=selected
 if selected and was==false then
  task.defer(function()
   if not o.Parent then return end
   centre(o) local sc=scaleOf(o) sc.Scale=.9 self:Tween(sc,POP,{Scale=1})
  end)
 end
end
-- A short bump when a displayed value changes (steppers). Frequent market readouts do not use this.
function FX:Bump(o,value)
 if self.Preview or not o.Parent then return end
 if self.Calm then self:Mem(o:GetFullName()).Value=value;return end
 local m=self:Mem(o:GetFullName())
 local was=m.Value m.Value=value
 if was~=nil and was~=value then
  local sc=scaleOf(o,"BumpScale") sc.Scale=1.16 self:Tween(sc,BOUNCE,{Scale=1})
 end
end
function FX:Shake(o)
 if self.Preview or not o.Parent then return end
 if o:GetAttribute("FixedGeometry")or self.Calm then self:Ring(o,Color3.fromRGB(255,81,127));return end
 -- Establish the same anchor as Bind before capturing the rest position. A deferred Bind
 -- must never centre a control halfway through a shake and invalidate that saved position.
 centre(o)
 local m=self:Mem(o:GetFullName())
 if m.Shaking then return end m.Shaking=true
 local base=o.Position
 local offsets={-7,6,-4,3,0}
 task.spawn(function()
  for _,dx in ipairs(offsets)do
   if not o.Parent then break end
   local t=TweenService:Create(o,TweenInfo.new(.035,Enum.EasingStyle.Sine),{Position=base+UDim2.fromOffset(dx,0)})
   t:Play() t.Completed:Wait()
  end
  if o.Parent then o.Position=base end
  m.Shaking=false
 end)
end
-- Popup entrance: scale from 90% with a light overshoot and fade the backdrop in.
function FX:Open(dialog,backdrop,fromBottom)
 if self.Preview then return end
 if dialog and dialog.Parent and not self.Calm then
  if fromBottom then
   local target=dialog.Position dialog.Position=target+UDim2.fromOffset(0,math.min(80,dialog.AbsoluteSize.Y*.25))
   self:Tween(dialog,TweenInfo.new(.24,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Position=target})
  else
   centre(dialog) local sc=scaleOf(dialog,"PopScale") sc.Scale=.9 self:Tween(sc,POP,{Scale=1})
  end
 end
 if backdrop and backdrop.Parent then
  local t=backdrop.BackgroundTransparency backdrop.BackgroundTransparency=1
  self:Tween(backdrop,TweenInfo.new(.16,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{BackgroundTransparency=t})
 end
end
-- Popup exit: the closed popup is moved out of the canvas (which is about to be rebuilt) into a
-- non-interactive CanvasGroup that fades and shrinks, then is destroyed.
function FX:Ghost(items)
 if self.Preview or not self.Root or #items==0 then for _,o in ipairs(items)do o:Destroy()end return end
 local ghost=Instance.new("CanvasGroup") ghost.Name="PopupGhost" ghost.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1) ghost.BackgroundTransparency=1
 ghost.BorderSizePixel=0 ghost.ZIndex=6 pcall(function()ghost.Interactable=false end)
 ghost.Parent=self.Root
 for _,o in ipairs(items)do
  for _,d in ipairs(o:GetDescendants())do if d:IsA("GuiButton")or d:IsA("TextBox")then d.Active=false pcall(function()d.Interactable=false end)end end
  o.Parent=ghost
  if o.Name~="OverlayBackdrop"and o.Name~="SheetBackdrop"and not self.Calm then
   centre(o) self:Tween(scaleOf(o,"PopScale"),TweenInfo.new(.13,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.In),{Scale=.94})
  end
 end
 local t=TweenService:Create(ghost,TweenInfo.new(.13,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.In),{GroupTransparency=1})
 t.Completed:Connect(function()ghost:Destroy()end) t:Play()
 task.delay(.5,function()if ghost.Parent then ghost:Destroy()end end)
end
-- Effects that must outlive a rebuild (success rings) live on a layer above the canvas.
function FX:Layer()
 if self.Preview or not self.Root then return nil end
 local layer=self.Root:FindFirstChild("EffectsLayer")
 if not layer then
  layer=Instance.new("Frame") layer.Name="EffectsLayer" layer.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1) layer.BackgroundTransparency=1
  layer.BorderSizePixel=0 layer.ZIndex=7 layer.Active=false layer.Parent=self.Root
 end
 return layer
end
-- Expanding glow ring around a control's on-screen rectangle.
function FX:Ring(o,color,radius)
 local layer=self:Layer() if not layer or not o or not o.Parent then return end
 local p=o.AbsolutePosition-self.Root.AbsolutePosition local s=o.AbsoluteSize
 local ring=Instance.new("Frame") ring.Name="SuccessRing" ring.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
 ring.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(p.X+s.X/2,p.Y+s.Y/2) ring.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(s.X,s.Y)
 ring.BackgroundColor3=color ring.BackgroundTransparency=.7 ring.BorderSizePixel=0 ring.ZIndex=8
 local c=Instance.new("UICorner") c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,radius or 12) c.Parent=ring
 local st=Instance.new("UIStroke") st.Color=color st.Thickness=3 st.Parent=ring
 ring.Parent=layer
 local info=TweenInfo.new(.5,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
 TweenService:Create(ring,info,{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(s.X+26,s.Y+26),BackgroundTransparency=1}):Play()
 local fade=TweenService:Create(st,info,{Transparency=1}) fade.Completed:Connect(function()ring:Destroy()end) fade:Play()
end
function FX:Pulse(o)
 if self.Preview or not o or not o.Parent then return end
 if o:GetAttribute("FixedGeometry")or self.Calm then self:Ring(o,Color3.fromRGB(46,249,160));return end
 centre(o) local sc=scaleOf(o) sc.Scale=1.07 self:Tween(sc,BOUNCE,{Scale=1})
end
-- Looping decorations (loading dots, coach highlight) are stopped before each rebuild.
function FX:Loop(tween) table.insert(self.Loops,tween) tween:Play() return tween end
function FX:StopLoops() for _,t in ipairs(self.Loops)do t:Cancel()end table.clear(self.Loops) end
function FX:Destroy()
 self.Alive=false self:StopLoops()
 for o,t in pairs(self.Tweens)do t:Cancel()end
 if self.Folder then self.Folder:Destroy() end
 if self.Group then self.Group:Destroy() end
 local layer=self.Root and self.Root:FindFirstChild("EffectsLayer") if layer then layer:Destroy() end
end
return FX
WelcomeGuide.luau:
-- Welcome guide: Bucky the bull greets new players and walks them through four tiny missions on the
-- real trading controls: pick a market, set the safety net, place a trade, close it. A mission only
-- completes from the real action (a market selection, saved protection settings, a server-confirmed
-- fill, a server-confirmed close). Finishing or skipping is saved on the player's profile through the
-- existing Tutorial flag, so returning players get a short welcome back instead. Replay from Help.
-- Lives on its own ScreenGui above the terminal, so the terminal's full rebuilds never reset it.
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
local TextService=game:GetService("TextService")
local GuiService=game:GetService("GuiService")
local Mascot=require(script.Parent.Mascot)
local Confetti=require(script.Parent.Confetti)
local Guide={} Guide.__index=Guide

-- ── Small drawing helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function new(class,name,parent,props)
 local o=Instance.new(class);o.Name=name
 for k,v in pairs(props or {})do o[k]=v end
 if parent then o.Parent=parent end
 return o
end
local function frame(parent,name,x,y,w,h,color,z,props)
 local f=new("Frame",name,nil,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h),BackgroundColor3=color or K.Ink,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=z or 1,Active=false})
 for k,v in pairs(props or {})do f[k]=v end
 f.Parent=parent;return f
end
local function corner(o,r)return new("UICorner","Corners",o,{CornerRadius=typeof(r)=="UDim"and r or UDim.new(0,r or 12)})end
local function stroke(o,color,t)return new("UIStroke","Border",o,{Color=color or INK,Thickness=t or 2,ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border})end
local function shade(o,a,b)return new("UIGradient","Shade",o,{Color=ColorSequence.new(a,b),Rotation=90})end
local function label(parent,name,text,x,y,w,h,size,color,z,props)
 local l=new("TextLabel",name,nil,{Text=text,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h),BackgroundTransparency=1,Font=FONT,TextSize=size,
  TextColor3=color or K.Text,ZIndex=z or 1,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,TextWrapped=true})
 for k,v in pairs(props or {})do l[k]=v end
 l.Parent=parent;return l
end
local function outline(l,color,t)return new("UIStroke","TextOutline",l,{Color=color or INK,Thickness=t or 1.5,ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual,LineJoinMode=Enum.LineJoinMode.Round})end
local function textHeight(text,size,width)return math.ceil(TextService:GetTextSize(text,size,FONT,Vector2.new(math.max(10,width),4000)).Y)end
local function textWidth(text,size)return math.ceil(TextService:GetTextSize(text,size,FONT,Vector2.new(4000,200)).X)end
local function check(parent,size,color,z)
 local box=frame(parent,"Check",0,0,size,size,color,z,{BackgroundTransparency=1})
 for i,seg in ipairs({{.24,.54,.43,.73},{.43,.73,.78,.3}})do
  local a,b=Vector2.new(seg[1]*size,seg[2]*size),Vector2.new(seg[3]*size,seg[4]*size);local d=b-a
  local l=frame(box,"Stroke"..i,(a.X+b.X)/2,(a.Y+b.Y)/2,d.Magnitude+size*.15,size*.15,color,z,{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Rotation=math.deg(math.atan2(d.Y,d.X))})
  corner(l,UDim.new(.5,0))
 end
 return box
end
-- Speech bubble: flat white card, cyan rim, and a tail on its left edge at tailY pointing at Bucky.
local function speech(parent,name,x,y,w,h,tailY,z)
 local tail=frame(parent,name.."Tail",x-3,y+tailY,18,18,K.Bubble,z,{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Rotation=45});stroke(tail,K.Cyan,3)
 local b=frame(parent,name,x,y,w,h,K.Bubble,z);corner(b,18);stroke(b,K.Cyan,3)
 -- Covers the rim where the tail joins, so the tail reads as part of the bubble.
 frame(b,"Join",-4,tailY-7,9,14,K.Bubble,z+1)
 return b
end
local function overlaps(a,b,pad)
 pad=pad or 0
 return a and b and a.X<b.X+b.W+pad and b.X<a.X+a.W+pad and a.Y<b.Y+b.H+pad and b.Y<a.Y+a.H+pad
end

  Phase="Waiting",Step=1,Done={},Connections={},Alive=true,Minimized=false,Typed=0,Speech="",Mobile=false},Guide)
 local stale=ctx.Gui.Parent and ctx.Gui.Parent:FindFirstChild("GetFundedGuide");if stale then stale:Destroy()end
